## About this programme

Newcastle University Business School runs a full-time MBA (programme code 5823F) on its Newcastle city centre campus. The course lasts 12 months, is taught on campus in English, and starts in September 2027.

The programme has three phases of modules, covering subjects such as finance, marketing, strategy, operations and entrepreneurship. You also choose two electives, and complete a consultancy project with a live client. The module list on the course page is an example, published before each year.

The most important thing for an Indian applicant: you need a 2:1 degree (or an equivalent) and at least three years of full-time work after your degree, with managerial responsibility.

## Can you get in?

**Your degree.** You need a 2:1 honours degree, or an international equivalent. A 2:1 is a UK degree grade. For an Indian degree, the grade that counts depends on the university you studied at. Newcastle sorts Indian universities into three sections. At a Section 1 university, a 2:1 means 60% or a CGPA of 6.0 out of 10. CGPA stands for cumulative grade point average.

**Work experience.** You need the equivalent of at least three years of significant, full-time work after your degree, with managerial responsibility. Exceptional applicants without the degree may be considered with more than five years of experience.

**GMAT.** The GMAT is a business school admissions test. You do not need to take it to study this MBA.

**English.** You need IELTS (International English Language Testing System) 6.5 overall, with at least 6.0 in each sub-skill. This is higher than the university's general rule of 5.5 in each sub-skill.

**Selection.** You send academic transcripts, a CV, a personal statement, English test results if you need to show them, and two referees. A referee is a person who writes a reference for you. All selected applicants are interviewed. You are also considered for MBA scholarships at interview.

## What it costs

**Tuition** for the full 12-month programme is **£34,400**.

**Deposit.** Students from India must pay a **£3,000** tuition deposit, or send an official sponsorship letter, by **27 August 2027**. A deposit is an advance payment that secures your place. A sponsorship letter is an official letter from the person or organisation paying for your studies. The deposit is non-refundable, and it is taken off your tuition when you register. If you need an ATAS certificate (explained under visa documents below), the date is **13 August 2027**.

**Money for your visa.** The UK student visa asks you to show that you can pay your living costs. This is money you show, not a fee to the university. Newcastle is outside London, so the rate for courses outside London applies: **£1,171** for each month of your course, for up to **9 months**. You must have had this money for **28 days in a row**. The last day of that 28-day period must be within **31 days** of the day you apply.

### First-year example

| Item | How it is worked out | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| Tuition | Full programme | £34,400 |
| Visa living money | £1,171 × 9 months | £10,539 |
| Student visa application fee | Applying from outside the UK | £558 |
| Immigration Health Surcharge | £776 + £388 (a visa of about 17 months) | £1,164 |
| **First-year total** | £34,400 + £10,539 + £558 + £1,164 | **£46,661** |

Your visa runs longer than your course. For a 12-month course it lasts about 17 months (1 month before the course and 4 months after). A visa of more than one year and up to 18 months pays the yearly £776 plus half of it, £388, so the surcharge is **£1,164**.

This is an example, not a budget. It leaves out flights, rent and everyday spending. Amounts change, so confirm them on gov.uk before you apply.

Newcastle says new international students are guaranteed accommodation for one year, subject to certain conditions.

Read the [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide) for the full rules. To compare costs across UK universities, use the [UK total cost breakdown](/study-abroad/study-in/uk/uk-total-cost-breakdown).

### Other visa documents

- **A CAS** (Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies). Your course provider issues it, and you need it to apply.
- **A valid passport.**
- **English at CEFR level B2 or above.** CEFR is a common scale for rating language ability. Your university can assess your English itself.
- **A TB test, if you need one.** India is on the UK list of countries where the test applies. You need the test if all three of these are true: you are coming to the UK for 6 months or more; you have lived in a listed country for 6 months or more; you were living in a listed country within the last 6 months. The test must be done at a clinic approved by the Home Office.
- **An ATAS certificate, if your course needs one.** ATAS is the Academic Technology Approval Scheme. Indian nationals are not on the exempt list. You must have the certificate before you start the course.

## Funding

Newcastle lists these awards for international students. Check each award page for the courses it covers.

- **Vice-Chancellor's Excellence award.** Up to 50% of tuition, for students assessed as international for fee purposes. You must have applied for your degree offer by 31 May 2027. The scholarship deadline is 8 June 2027. Apply through the Apply to Newcastle Portal.
- **MBA scholarships.** You are considered for MBA scholarships at interview.
- **General line.** The MBA course page says you may be eligible for a scholarship worth 25% off the international fee.

For all of Newcastle's funding, see the [global scholarships page](https://www.ncl.ac.uk/study/global-scholarships/).

## Deadlines and intakes

There is no application closing date. The course starts in September 2027. Newcastle suggests international students apply at least two months before the start.

You cannot apply for your visa earlier than 6 months before the course starts, so plan your visa application after your offer.

| Date | What is due |
|---|---|
| 31 May 2027 | Degree offer applied for (Vice-Chancellor's Excellence award) |
| 8 June 2027 | Vice-Chancellor's Excellence scholarship deadline |
| 13 August 2027 | Deposit or sponsorship letter, if your course needs an ATAS certificate |
| 27 August 2027 | £3,000 deposit or sponsorship letter, for students from India |

## How to apply

1. Check that you meet the entry rules: a 2:1 or equivalent, three years of managerial work experience, and IELTS 6.5 with 6.0 in each sub-skill.
2. Apply online through the Apply to Newcastle Portal. Scholarship applications use the same portal.
3. Send your academic transcripts, CV, personal statement, English test results if needed, and the details of two referees.
4. Attend an interview. All selected applicants are interviewed.
5. Pay the £3,000 deposit, or send an official sponsorship letter, by 27 August 2027.
6. Get your CAS from Newcastle. Then apply for your visa, following the [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide).

## After the programme

- **Graduate visa.** This lets you stay and work in the UK after your course. It lasts 2 years if you apply on or before 31 December 2026, and 18 months if you apply on or after 1 January 2027. The application fee is £937.
- **Careers support.** A Careers Consultant offers one-to-one coaching.
- **Outcomes.** Newcastle's course page says 91% of graduates are in work or further study 15 months after graduation. The figure comes from the Graduate Outcomes Survey, 2018/19 to 2023/24.
- **Accreditation.** Newcastle University Business School is accredited by AACSB, EQUIS and AMBA. The page says AMBA has accredited it for over 35 years.

## Who it suits

**A strong choice if:**

- You have at least three years of full-time work with managerial responsibility.
- You want a consultancy project with a live client.
- You want a business school accredited by AACSB, EQUIS and AMBA.
- You want the option of the Graduate visa after your course.

**Think carefully if:**

- You have less than three years of work experience, or no managerial responsibility in it.
- You cannot reach IELTS 6.5 with 6.0 in each sub-skill.
- You cannot pay the deposit or show the visa money set out in the cost section.

## Sources

- [Newcastle University: MBA (5823F)](https://www.ncl.ac.uk/postgraduate/degrees/5823f/). Checked on 3 November 2026.
- [Newcastle University: global scholarships](https://www.ncl.ac.uk/study/global-scholarships/). Checked on 3 November 2026.
- [Newcastle University: Vice-Chancellor's Excellence scholarship](https://www.ncl.ac.uk/postgraduate/fees-funding/search-funding/?code=vces27). Checked on 3 November 2026.
- [Newcastle University: India country page](https://www.ncl.ac.uk/international/country/india/). Accommodation guarantee. Checked on 3 November 2026.
- [Student visa](https://www.gov.uk/student-visa) and [documents you must provide](https://www.gov.uk/student-visa/documents-you-must-provide). Checked on 1 November 2026.
- [Financial evidence for the student route](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/financial-evidence-for-student-and-child-student-route-applicants) and [Immigration Rules, Appendix Student](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/immigration-rules/immigration-rules-appendix-student). Checked on 1 November 2026.
- [Immigration Health Surcharge: how much you pay](https://www.gov.uk/healthcare-immigration-application/how-much-pay). Checked on 3 November 2026.
- [English language for the Student visa](https://www.gov.uk/student-visa/knowledge-of-english). Checked on 1 November 2026.
- [TB test for visa applicants](https://www.gov.uk/tb-test-visa) and [countries where you need a TB test](https://www.gov.uk/tb-test-visa/countries-where-you-need-a-tb-test-to-enter-the-uk). Checked on 1 November 2026.
- [ATAS guidance](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/academic-technology-approval-scheme). Checked on 1 November 2026.
- [Graduate visa](https://www.gov.uk/graduate-visa) and [Graduate visa costs](https://www.gov.uk/graduate-visa/how-much-it-costs). Checked on 1 November 2026.

Fees and rules change. Always confirm on the university's own website before you pay or apply.

## About this programme

The University of Glasgow MBA is a Master of Business Administration. It runs for 12 months, full time, at the Adam Smith Business School on the Gilmorehill campus in Glasgow. Teaching starts in September and is in English. The MBA is AMBA-accredited, and the business school also holds AACSB and EQUIS accreditation.

**The most important rule for you:** the MBA asks for at least three years of professional work experience, as well as a degree. Check this before you pay for an application.

The core modules are Decision Making Under Uncertainty, Financial Information and Analysis, Global Economy, Managing Operations, Marketing Management, People & Organisations, and Strategic Management. You can specialise in finance, marketing or strategy, or explore areas such as entrepreneurship and sustainability. Optional courses include Strategy, Generative AI for Productivity and Growth, Innovation Management and Supply Chain Management.

The programme ends with an MBA Group Consultancy Project and a dissertation. You can take the Industry, Research or Start-up pathway, which runs from June to August. Industry projects are not guaranteed.

## Can you get in?

Check these points before you apply.

- **Degree.** An Honours degree, or a non-UK equivalent, in any subject. Ask the university how your Indian degree and marks are assessed before you apply.
- **Work experience.** A minimum of three years of professional work experience.
- **Personal statement and CV.** A personal statement, and a detailed CV that describes your work experience.
- **Reference.** One reference letter on headed paper. The MBA also accepts an employer reference.
- **Interview.** You will be invited to an interview on MS Teams. It takes about 30 minutes and comes after the first admissions stage.

**English.** IELTS is an English test with four parts: listening, reading, writing and speaking. You need an overall score of **6.5**, with no part below **6.0**. This applies to IELTS Academic, IELTS Academic for UKVI and IELTS Academic online.

Other accepted tests include TOEFL iBT, PTE Academic, Cambridge C1 and C2, Oxford ELLT, LanguageCert and the Oxford Test of English. Duolingo needs 120 overall, with 120 for writing and no part below 110. A degree from a majority-English-speaking country also counts. Your test must be taken within 2 years and 5 months of your programme start.

Your visa also needs English at CEFR level B2 for degree-level study. CEFR is the common scale for language ability, from A1 to C2.

## What it costs

Tuition for international and EU students is **£41,100** for the full 12-month course in the 2027-28 fee year.

- **Application fee:** **£25** per application, paid by card when you apply online.
- **Deposit:** international and EU applicants pay a **£2,000** deposit to secure a place. It is not in the total below.
- **Living money for the visa:** Glasgow is outside London, so you must show **£1,171** for each month of your course, for up to 9 months. That is **£10,539**. You must have this money for 28 days in a row. The last day of those 28 days must fall within 31 days of the day you apply.
- **Visa fee:** **£558** to apply for a Student visa from outside the UK.
- **Immigration Health Surcharge (IHS):** a fee you pay with your visa so you can use the NHS, the UK's public health service. It is **£776 for each year** of your visa.

### Worked first-year cost

| Item | How it is worked out | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| Tuition | Full-time fee, 2027-28 | £41,100 |
| Living money for the visa | £1,171 × 9 months | £10,539 |
| Student visa application fee | Applying from outside the UK | £558 |
| Immigration Health Surcharge | £776 + £388 (a visa of about 17 months) | £1,164 |
| **Total** | £41,100 + £10,539 + £558 + £1,164 | **£53,361** |

Your visa runs longer than your course. For a 12-month course it lasts about 17 months (1 month before the course and 4 months after). A visa of more than one year and up to 18 months pays the yearly £776 plus half of it, £388, so the surcharge is **£1,164**.

For the visa rules in full, read our [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide). To compare costs with other UK universities, see the [UK total cost breakdown](/study-abroad/study-in/uk/uk-total-cost-breakdown).

## Funding

The Glasgow MBA Scholarship gives tuition waivers. Offer holders who pass the MBA interview are considered. The value of the award depends on your interview score and your scholarship application.

- **30%** of tuition: **£12,330** (Achievement award)
- **50%** of tuition: **£20,550**
- **70%** of tuition: **£28,770** (Entrepreneurial Leaders award)
- **100%** of tuition: the Global Impact, Adam Smith Diamond Leadership and MBA Scholarship for Women with the 30% Club awards. The Scottish Excellence award is for Home status students only.

The page lists 1st Class Honours and/or excellent professional achievement as eligibility. The scholarship is not limited to students from India. Fully funded awards are assessed after 31 March 2027.

Glasgow awards cannot be combined. Only the highest-value award is paid.

## Deadlines and intakes

| Intake | Apply by | Where to apply |
|---|---|---|
| September 2027 (teaching starts) | 31 July 2027, for all applicants | Online, through the university application system |

The MBA has one deadline for all applicants. You can save your application and return to it, but you must submit it within 42 days of starting.

Apply early. You can apply for a UK visa no earlier than 6 months before your course starts.

## How to apply

1. **Check your degree and work experience.** You need an Honours degree or a non-UK equivalent, and at least three years of professional work experience.
2. **Take an English test.** Get an overall score of 6.5 with no part below 6.0, taken within 2 years and 5 months of your programme start.
3. **Gather your documents.** You need your degree certificates (if you have completed them), official transcripts, official English translations, one reference letter, your English test evidence, any programme-specific documents, and a copy of your passport photo page.
4. **Write your personal statement and detailed CV.** The CV should describe your work experience.
5. **Apply online by 31 July 2027.** Pay the **£25** application fee by card.
6. **Attend your interview.** It takes place on MS Teams and lasts about 30 minutes.
7. **Pay the deposit.** The offer letter gives the deadline for paying the **£2,000** deposit.
8. **Apply for your visa.** The university issues a CAS (Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies) once it accepts you. You need it for your visa application. Some applicants from India also need a TB test at a Home Office approved clinic. Follow our [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide) for each visa step.

## After the programme

- **Graduate visa.** This is the UK post-study work visa. It lasts **2 years** if you apply on or before 31 December 2026, and **18 months** if you apply on or after 1 January 2027. The application fee is **£937**. Your MBA starts in September 2027, so the 18-month rule applies to you.
- **Careers support.** An MBA Development Manager provides careers support to MBA students.
- **Alumni.** The university says recent alumni have joined Amazon, Barclays, Deloitte and Diageo.

## Who it suits

**A strong choice if:**

- You have an Honours degree, or a non-UK equivalent, and at least three years of professional work experience.
- You want a 12-month, full-time MBA that starts in September.
- You can reach IELTS 6.5 overall, with no part below 6.0.
- You want to specialise in finance, marketing or strategy.

**Think carefully if:**

- You have less than three years of professional work experience.
- You cannot show £1,171 a month for up to 9 months, held for 28 days in a row.
- You do not have a scholarship and cannot cover £53,361 for the first year.

## Sources

Checked on 1 November 2026 (UK government): [Student visa](https://www.gov.uk/student-visa), [Financial evidence for student route applicants](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/financial-evidence-for-student-and-child-student-route-applicants), [Student visa money rules](https://www.gov.uk/student-visa/money), [Healthcare surcharge](https://www.gov.uk/healthcare-immigration-application/how-much-pay), [Knowledge of English](https://www.gov.uk/student-visa/knowledge-of-english), [Graduate visa](https://www.gov.uk/graduate-visa), [Graduate visa costs](https://www.gov.uk/graduate-visa/how-much-it-costs), and [TB test for visa applicants](https://www.gov.uk/tb-test-visa).

## About this programme

The Full-time MBA (Master of Business Administration) is taught by Alliance Manchester Business School at the University of Manchester. It is a full-time programme of 15 or 18 months, and you choose the route. It starts in September 2027, is taught in English, and runs on the Manchester city campus.

The school is triple accredited by AMBA, AACSB and EQUIS. Each class typically has 100 students from 30 nationalities.

The most important point for you: you need at least three years of work experience after your degree.

## What you need to get in

**Your degree.** The school normally looks for an upper second-class (2:1) honours result in the UK system. Contact the recruitment team if you are not sure how your Indian degree will be assessed.

**Work experience.** You need at least three years of work after your degree. Your career should show strong, steady progress.

**An admissions test.** You need one of these three tests:

- **MAT** (Manchester Admissions Test), the university's own test.
- **GMAT** (Graduate Management Admission Test). GMAT Superscores are considered.
- **GRE** (Graduate Record Examination).

**English.** You need an overall **IELTS** (International English Language Testing System) score of **6.5**. You also need at least **6.5** in speaking and writing, and at least **6.0** in reading and listening.

Other tests the school accepts:

- **TOEFL iBT:** 90 overall, with 22 in speaking and writing and 20 in reading and listening.
- **PTE Academic:** 59, with 59 in each part.
- **Cambridge CAE** 176, or **CPE**.
- **LanguageCert ESOL SELT B2** 156 (UKVI version).
- **Indian Standard XII English:** 80% (CBSE or CISCE).

At-home or online test versions are not accepted.

**Interview.** Some applicants are invited to an interview. It is Stage 3 of the process, and it is by invitation only.

## What it costs

The tuition fee is **£51,500**. This is the fee for the whole programme, whether you take 15 or 18 months to finish.

**Deposit.** Manchester asks for a deposit of at least **£2,500** before it issues your CAS. A deposit is an upfront payment you make before your course. The CAS (Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies) is the document a university issues so you can apply for a UK student visa. The £2,500 deposit is a general postgraduate rule that does not name the MBA. The school takes the deposit off your fees when you register.

**Application fee.** The programme has no application fee.

**Visa money.** For a UK student visa you must show you can pay for your living costs. Manchester is outside London, so you must show **£1,171** for each month of your course, for up to **9 months**. That is **£10,539**. You must have this money for **28 days in a row**. The last day of those 28 days must fall within **31 days** of the day you apply. You show this money to the government. You do not pay it to the university.

**Visa fee.** The Student visa application fee from outside the UK is **£558**.

**Health surcharge.** The Immigration Health Surcharge is **£776 for each year** of your visa.

### First-year cost example

| Item | How it is worked out | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| Tuition | Whole programme fee | £51,500 |
| Visa living money | £1,171 × 9 months | £10,539 |
| Visa application fee | Fee from outside the UK | £558 |
| Health surcharge | £776 × 2 (a visa of about 20 to 23 months) | £1,552 |
| **Total** | £51,500 + £10,539 + £558 + £1,552 | **£64,149** |

This is a first-year example, not a full budget.

Your visa runs longer than your course. A 15- to 18-month course gets a visa of 20 to 23 months. That is more than 18 months, so the surcharge is two full years: **£1,552**.

Read the [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide) for the visa rules. For a wider view, see the [UK total cost breakdown](/study-abroad/study-in/uk/uk-total-cost-breakdown).

## Funding

**Manchester Bee scholarships.** These MBA awards range from **£5,150** to **£25,750**. Each one suits a different profile. Bee Global, for example, is for applicants from under-represented regions, and Bee Empowered is for female applicants. You can hold only one award. The awards are open in all admissions rounds.

**Named scholarships.** The school also lists other MBA scholarships, including the Forte Foundation Fellowship Scholarships for Women and the Joseph Wright Scholarships.

**Alumni discount.** Graduates of The University of Manchester or UMIST get **20%** off the tuition fees they pay themselves.

For the full details, see the [fees and funding page](https://www.alliancembs.manchester.ac.uk/study/mba/full-time-mba/fees-funding/).

## Deadlines and intakes

The programme starts in **September 2027**. Applications go in through staged rounds. Each round closes at 17:00 UK time. The first two rounds have closed.

| Round | Application deadline |
|---|---|
| 3 | 1 December 2026 |
| 4 | 4 January 2027 |
| 5 | 1 February 2027 |
| 6 | 1 March 2027 |
| 7 | 1 April 2027 |
| 8 | **9 May 2027** |

Round 9 (1 July 2027) is for UK candidates and candidates who do not need a UK student visa, so it is not for you.

Apply early. You can apply for a UK student visa up to **6 months** before your course starts. Government guidance says a decision usually takes **3 weeks** if you apply from outside the UK. Pay the deposit early, because your CAS comes after it.

## How to apply

1. **Prepare your documents.** Gather your CV, and your degree transcripts and certificates in PDF.
2. **Take your admissions test.** Choose MAT, GMAT or GRE, and send the report with your application.
3. **Take your English test.** Your report must meet the scores listed above.
4. **Write your essays.** You need an admission essay and the MBA application essays.
5. **Apply through the University of Manchester Application Portal.** There is no application fee.
6. **Ask for at least one reference.** Your referee completes an online reference form.
7. **Complete the scholarship video, if you apply for an award.** You have **7 days** from receiving the email to finish it.
8. **Attend an interview if you are invited.** Interviews are by invitation only.

## After the programme

The five core courses are:

- Leading Global Transitions
- Leading People and Organisations
- Business Accounting and Finance
- Strategy and Innovation
- Operationalising and Communicating Value

You can choose electives, including Big Data Analytics, Digital Marketing Strategy, Negotiation Skills, and Venture Capital and Private Equity. International electives run at five global centres.

You also complete three real-world consultancy projects. An optional **10-12 week** internship is available, and there is an overseas study tour.

The school says its graduates work in consulting, tech, finance, the NHS and pharma.

The Graduate Route lets you work in the UK after you finish. If you apply on or before 31 December 2026, the visa lasts **2 years**. If you apply on or after 1 January 2027, it lasts **18 months**. The application fee is **£937**. Check the [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide) for the rules.

## Who it suits

**A strong choice if:**

- You have at least three years of work experience after your degree, with steady progress.
- You can reach IELTS **6.5** overall, with **6.5** in speaking and writing.
- You can pay the first-year costs above, or you win a Bee scholarship or qualify for the alumni discount.

**Think carefully if:**

- You have less than three years of work experience.
- You cannot apply by round 8, which closes on **9 May 2027**.
- You need a start other than September 2027.

## About this programme

The Full-time MBA (Master of Business Administration) is run by Warwick Business School (WBS), a department of the University of Warwick. It is taught in English on the Warwick campus in Coventry. You can choose the 12-month format, or one of two 16-month formats: one with an internship, or one with a partner school exchange.

You study nine required modules and four or five electives, depending on the format. Core modules cover finance, marketing, operations, organisational behaviour, and digital systems and AI. You also take a required overseas elective. You can specialise in digital and AI, entrepreneurship, or social and environmental sustainability.

Check one rule before anything else. You need at least three years of professional business experience after your degree. Internships do not count.

## Can you get in?

**Your degree.** Warwick prefers a second-class honours degree (2:2) from a UK university, or an equivalent overseas degree, but does not make it essential. Warwick welcomes applications from good degrees at respected universities in India.

**Indian grades.** Warwick's India table covers Category 1 institutions: IITs, IIMs, IISERs, IIITs, NITs and other listed institutions. On courses that require a UK 2:2, the minimum is 58% (CGPA 5.8 out of 10). For other institutions, the minimum depends on the institution, so check Warwick's India page before you apply.

**Work experience.** You need at least three years of post-graduate professional business experience. Internships do not count.

**GMAT or GRE.** You need a GMAT score, a GRE score or the Warwick Test. There is no minimum score. The GMAT is a standard business school test. The GRE is a general test for graduate study. Some candidates may be offered the Warwick Test as an alternative, after interview. For reference, the class average is 670 on the GMAT (10th Edition) and 615 on the Focus Edition. A competitive GRE score is 160 in Verbal and 160 in Quant.

**Interview.** You will have an interview of about 60 minutes. It is face to face or on Microsoft Teams. It is run by Recruitment, CareersPlus or an academic.

**English.** IELTS (International English Language Testing System) is an English test. Warwick asks for IELTS Academic with an overall score of 7.0. You need at least 6.0 in each of the four parts. One-skill retakes are not accepted. Other accepted tests:

- Cambridge CPE or CAE, with 190 overall.
- PTE Academic, with 70 overall and at least 59 in each section. Take it at a test centre; online is not accepted.
- Duolingo, with 130 overall.

**Documents.** Send a digital copy of your transcript and degree certificate, translated into English. You need two professional references, one from your line manager. If you left education within the last five years, one reference can be academic and one professional.

## What it costs

Tuition is the same for UK, EU and international students. The 12-month format costs £62,500. The 16-month formats cost £63,750, which includes a £1,250 extension fee.

**Tuition deposit.** You lodge a £6,000 deposit within four weeks of receiving your offer. A deposit is an advance payment towards your tuition. It is part of the total fee, not an extra cost.

**Paying tuition.** You can pay in one lump sum at the start of the year. Or you can pay 50% on the first day of your academic year, 25% on the first day of month 4, and 25% on the first day of month 7.

**Application fee.** The application fee is £80. It is non-refundable.

**Money for the visa.** Coventry is outside London, so the outside-London rate applies. You must show £1,171 for each month of your course, for up to 9 months. You must have had this money for 28 days in a row. The end date of that 28-day period must be within 31 days of the day you apply for your visa.

**Visa and health fees.** The student visa application fee is £558 if you apply from outside the UK. You also pay the Immigration Health Surcharge: £776 for each year of your visa. You need a Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies (CAS) from your course provider. The CAS is the document Warwick issues to confirm your place for the visa.

**Worked first-year total, 12-month format**

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Tuition | £62,500 |
| Money for the visa: £1,171 × 9 months | £10,539 |
| Student visa application fee | £558 |
| Immigration Health Surcharge, one year: £1,164 | £1,164 |
| **Total** | **£74,761** |

The sum is £62,500 + £10,539 + £558 + £1,164 = £74,761.

Your visa runs longer than your course. For a 12-month course it lasts about 17 months (1 month before the course and 4 months after). A visa of more than one year and up to 18 months pays the yearly £776 plus half of it, £388, so the surcharge is **£1,164**. The 16-month MBA gets a visa of about 21 months, so its surcharge is **£1,552**. This estimate does not include flights, rent or everyday spending.

Read how the visa works in our [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide). To compare costs at other UK universities, see the [UK total cost breakdown](/study-abroad/study-in/uk/uk-total-cost-breakdown).

## Funding

**WBS Scholarships.** WBS offers scholarships for its MBA and MSc courses. UK and international students can apply. When you apply, you indicate your interest in a scholarship category on the application form.

**MBA fee scholarships.** Exceptional candidates can receive 10% to 50% of the tuition fee. For September 2027 entry, that is £6,250 to £31,250. These awards are made on an ongoing basis, so apply early.

**Scholarship categories.** On the application form, you indicate interest in a category. Examples include Change Maker, Inspiring Females, LGBTQUA+ and Locally Resident (Coventry and Warwickshire). Each category has its own rules, and India is not named in any of them.

Warwick lists all its scholarships on its [scholarships page](https://warwick.ac.uk/study/scholarships-and-bursaries/scholarships/).

## Deadlines and intakes

The intake is September 2027. The course starts on 27 September 2027.

You apply through a web-based form run by WBS. Enquiries go to warwickmba@wbs.ac.uk.

| Round | Apply by | Decision |
|---|---|---|
| Round 2 | 15 November 2026 | 4 December 2026 |
| Round 3 | 10 January 2027 | 12 February 2027 |
| Round 4 | 21 March 2027 | 9 April 2027 |
| Round 5 (international deadline) | 30 May 2027 | 18 June 2027 |
| Round 6 (last round) | 1 August 2027 | 6 August 2027 |

Decisions take about four weeks.

## How to apply

1. Check that you meet the rules above, especially the three years of work experience.
2. Optional: request a consultation with WBS.
3. Apply online using the web-based form. You can save it and come back to it. The £80 application fee is non-refundable.
4. In the form, indicate your interest in a scholarship category if you want to be considered for one.
5. Upload your transcript and degree certificate, translated into English.
6. Make sure both professional references are sent.
7. Attend your interview, which takes about 60 minutes.
8. Wait for your offer letter.
9. Lodge the £6,000 deposit within four weeks of receiving your offer. Reply by the deadline in the offer letter.

## After the programme

Warwick says graduates from these courses have gone on to work for employers including Amazon, Deloitte, Goldman Sachs, HSBC, KPMG, McKinsey & Company and Unilever. CareersPlus, the careers service, offers weekly sessions and unlimited one-to-one coaching.

After the programme, you can apply for the Graduate visa. It lasts 2 years if you apply on or before 31 December 2026. It lasts 18 months if you apply from 1 January 2027. The application fee is £937.

## Who it suits

This programme suits you if you have at least three years of professional business experience. It also suits you if you want a choice of electives and a required overseas elective. The 16-month format with an internship gives you a longer internship.

Recent classes have had students from 48 nationalities over the last three years. The class is 40% female and 60% male, and the average age is 31. The class has 70 to 100 students in two cohorts.

## About this programme

The Master of Business Administration (MBA) at Coventry University is a one-year, full-time programme. It runs at Coventry University in Coventry. The same course page lists two specialist versions: MBA Global Marketing and MBA AI and Business Analytics. This page covers the MBA.

The MBA has compulsory modules that it shares with the other two versions. One is a 30-credit module on business transformation for sustainable value creation, which is compulsory for the MBA. The course ends with a 50-credit MBA Consultancy Project. You research a real business problem and propose a solution.

The most important thing for an Indian applicant: you need at least three years of relevant work experience after your degree, by the time the course starts.

For the university as a whole, read our [Coventry University page](/study-abroad/universities/coventry-university).

## Can you get in?

To get in, you need an honours degree at 2:2 or above, or an international equivalent, in any discipline. You also need at least three years of relevant work experience after your degree, by the time you start.

If your degree is from India, Coventry's international entry page sets these rules for postgraduate study:

- **60%** in a three-year undergraduate degree
- **55%** in a four-year undergraduate degree

Students from some named Indian universities can be considered with **55%** in a three-year degree. Ask Coventry how your marks are assessed for the MBA before you apply.

You also need an English test score. IELTS (International English Language Testing System) tests your reading, writing, listening and speaking. For the MBA, Coventry asks for an overall IELTS score of **6.5**, with no part lower than **5.5**.

## What it costs

The fees on this page are the 2027-28 figures shown on the MBA course page. Check the fee on the course page before you apply.

**Tuition is £21,825 a year** for international students. The course is one year long, so this is the full tuition.

Before the university releases your CAS (Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies), the document you need for your visa, you must pay a tuition deposit. Coventry's apply page says that students from Punjab, Uttarakhand and Haryana in India must pay the full first-year tuition fee as this deposit. Other Indian states are not named in that table, so ask Coventry what deposit applies to you. The due date is in your offer letter.

The UK student visa also asks you to show money for living costs. This is proof of money, not a fee. You keep it in your bank account. If you study outside London, you must show **£1,171 for each month** of your course, for up to **9 months**. You must have had this money for **28 days in a row**. The last day of that 28-day period must be within **31 days** of the day you apply. The UK government sets these amounts, so confirm them on gov.uk before you budget.

Two more visa costs apply. The visa application fee is **£558** when you apply from outside the UK. The Immigration Health Surcharge is a charge that gives you access to the NHS. It is **£776 for each year** of your visa.

Here is a worked example for one year of the MBA:

| Item | How it is worked out | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| Tuition, 2027-28 | One year of the course | £21,825 |
| Living money for the visa | £1,171 × 9 months | £10,539 |
| Visa application fee | Fee from outside the UK | £558 |
| Immigration Health Surcharge | £776 + £388 (a visa of about 17 months) | £1,164 |
| **First-year total** | £21,825 + £10,539 + £558 + £1,164 | **£34,086** |

The £10,539 is money you show, not money you pay. The example does not include flights or spending beyond the visa money.

Your visa runs longer than your course. For a 12-month course it lasts about 17 months (1 month before the course and 4 months after). A visa of more than one year and up to 18 months pays the yearly £776 plus half of it, £388, so the surcharge is **£1,164**.

For the visa rules, read our [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide). To compare costs across UK universities, see the [UK total cost breakdown](/study-abroad/study-in/uk/uk-total-cost-breakdown).

## Funding

**Coventry University Group Scholarship.** This gives **£2,000 a year** of study off tuition. It is for self-funded international students who pay international fees (EU Bursary holders are excluded), on full-time taught degrees at Coventry's UK Group campuses. You do not need to apply. Your CAS deposit must be cleared by the date in your offer letter, and you must enrol for the 2026/27 or 2027/28 academic year. Online courses are excluded. It cannot be combined with other scholarships, including the Alumni Discount.

For a one-year MBA where you qualify, tuition falls to **£19,825** (£21,825 − £2,000).

**Alumni discount.** Coventry graduates get **25% off** postgraduate courses. This is only for Coventry graduates.

No scholarship is listed for this MBA alone. The full list is on the university's [scholarships page](https://www.coventry.ac.uk/international-students-hub/apply-for-a-scholarship/).

## Deadlines and intakes

The MBA starts in September 2027, November 2027, January 2028, March 2028, May 2028 and July 2028. The apply page has its own deadline table. Use it to find the deadline for the start month you want.

Apply early. You can apply for your UK student visa no earlier than **6 months** before your course starts.

## How to apply

1. **Check the entry rules.** Confirm your degree and work experience against the rules above. Read the [international entry requirements](https://www.coventry.ac.uk/international-students-hub/entry-requirements/).
2. **Get your English test score.** You need IELTS 6.5 overall, with no part below 5.5.
3. **Apply online to Coventry.** Use the university's online application portal. Apply directly to the university. UCAS is for undergraduate courses, so do not use it.
4. **Upload your documents.** You need all academic transcripts, one academic reference, your personal statement, your degree or diploma certificates (or a work reference if you are employed), your English test score and a copy of your passport.
5. **Accept your offer and pay the deposit.** After you meet the offer conditions and pay the deposit, Coventry issues your CAS.
6. **Apply for your visa.** Use your CAS, your passport and your proof of money. You need a TB test if you are coming to the UK for 6 months or more, you have lived in India for 6 months or more, and you were living there in the last 6 months. The test must be done at a clinic approved by the Home Office. See the [TB test guidance](https://www.gov.uk/tb-test-visa).

## After the programme

The university offers one-to-one careers guidance for up to 18 months after the course. Its course page says graduates have worked for companies including TATA, Barclays Bank, Unilever and Shell. No salary figures are given.

**Graduate visa.** This is the post-study work visa. It may let you work in the UK after your course. If you apply on or before 31 December 2026, it lasts **2 years**. If you apply on or after 1 January 2027, it lasts **18 months**. The application fee is **£937**. Read the [Graduate visa guide](https://www.gov.uk/graduate-visa).

## Who it suits

**A strong choice if:**

- You have a 2:2 honours degree or equivalent, and at least three years of relevant work experience.
- You can reach IELTS 6.5, with no part below 5.5.
- You are self-funded and qualify for the £2,000 Group Scholarship.

**Think carefully if:**

- You will not have three years of relevant work experience by the start date.
- Your Indian marks are close to the 55% or 60% levels. Ask Coventry how they are assessed for the MBA.
- Your savings or family support will not cover the first-year total of £34,086.

## About this programme

The full-time MBA at Birmingham Business School is a one-year programme. You study at the Edgbaston campus in Birmingham, in person and in English. The school holds triple-crown accreditation from AACSB, AMBA and EQUIS. These are three international bodies that check business schools against high standards.

You take nine core modules worth 100 credits. You then choose a specialism in marketing, international business and strategy, or innovation and business transformation, or you pick electives.

The most important fact for you: tuition for international students is **£40,410** for the whole programme.

For the wider university, see our [University of Birmingham page](/study-abroad/universities/university-of-birmingham).

## Can you get in?

**Degree.** You need a 2.1 good Honours degree or equivalent. A 2.1 is a UK honours grade. For a bachelor's degree from India, Birmingham's India page says a 2.1 normally needs 55% to 60% or higher. Ask the admissions team how your marks will be assessed.

**Work experience.** You need at least three years of professional experience. The university usually expects five years. Without a first degree, you need at least ten years of work experience.

**GMAT.** GMAT is a standard business school admissions test. You do not need it for this MBA. If you already hold a GMAT score, the university accepts it and considers it.

**English.** IELTS is an English language test. Birmingham accepts several tests, including IELTS Academic, TOEFL iBT, PTE Academic and Cambridge English. Your result must be no more than two years old when the course starts. Ask the admissions team for the minimum score for this MBA before you book a test.

Your student visa also needs English at CEFR level B2 for a degree-level course. CEFR is a common scale for rating language skills.

**Selection.** You write a personal statement of no more than two pages, covering your reasons for an MBA, your career highlights and examples of managerial responsibility. You need one academic reference and one work reference. If you have no academic reference, two work references are accepted. You may be invited to an interview.

## What it costs

Birmingham is outside London, so the outside-London visa rule applies. This is the worked first-year total.

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Tuition for international students, whole one-year programme | £40,410 |
| Living money for your visa: £1,171 × 9 months | £10,539 |
| Student visa application fee, from outside the UK | £558 |
| Immigration Health Surcharge: £776 for each year of your visa | £1,164 |
| **Total** | **£52,671** |

The sum is £40,410 + £10,539 + £558 + £1,164 = £52,671. Travel and housing are not included.

**Living money is not a fee.** The visa rule is £1,171 for each month of your course outside London, up to 9 months. You must show this money in your bank account. You must have had enough money for 28 days in a row, and the end of that 28-day period must be within 31 days of the date you apply. You do not pay this money to the university.

**Health surcharge.** The Immigration Health Surcharge is a charge for using the NHS while you are in the UK. Your visa runs longer than your course. For a 12-month course it lasts about 17 months (1 month before the course and 4 months after). A visa of more than one year and up to 18 months pays the yearly £776 plus half of it, £388, so the surcharge is **£1,164**.

**Deposit.** Before the university issues your CAS, you pay a tuition fee deposit. A CAS (Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies) is the electronic letter from your university that your visa application needs. The deposit is taken off your tuition when you register. Ask the university for the deposit amount.

**Other payments.** There is no application fee for postgraduate taught courses. You can pay tuition in full or by instalments.

For the visa steps, read the [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide). To plan the whole budget, use the [UK total cost breakdown](/study-abroad/study-in/uk/uk-total-cost-breakdown).

## Funding

Two MBA scholarships give a tuition-fee discount. Both are open to offer-holders of all nationalities for the September 2027 start.

- **Purposeful Leader MBA Scholarship:** up to £20,000 off tuition. A small number of awards are made.
- **Responsible Business MBA Scholarship:** up to £15,000 off tuition. Several awards are made.

Applications open in October 2026. The first deadline is January 2027 and the final deadline is March 2027. Awards are assessed on a rolling basis, so apply early.

You apply after you receive your offer letter. The university then sends you a link. Through it, you submit a personal statement and an essay on responsible business.

Read the [MBA scholarship page](https://www.birmingham.ac.uk/study/scholarships-funding/mba-scholarship) for the full rules.

## Deadlines and intakes

| Intake | Who applies | Deadline | Where to apply |
|---|---|---|---|
| September 2027 | International applicants who need a visa | 2 July 2027 | University online admissions portal |
| September 2027 | UK and non-visa applicants | 27 August 2027 | University online admissions portal |

The university closes applications as soon as the programme is full. The earliest you can apply for a UK student visa is 6 months before your course starts.

## How to apply

1. **Check the entry rules.** You need a 2.1 degree or equivalent and at least three years of professional experience.
2. **Apply online.** Submit your application and supporting documents through the university's admissions portal. See the [MBA course page](https://www.birmingham.ac.uk/study/postgraduate/subjects/business-and-management-courses/mba).
3. **Prepare your documents.** You need:
   - evidence of your academic and professional qualifications
   - an up-to-date CV
   - one academic and one work reference, or two work references
   - a personal statement of no more than two pages
   - your English test result
   - translated transcripts, if they are not in English
4. **Attend an interview if invited.** You may be asked to interview as part of admissions.
5. **Accept your offer and pay the deposit.** Meet the conditions in your offer and pay the tuition fee deposit. The university then issues your CAS.

Read the [TB test page](https://www.gov.uk/tb-test-visa/countries-where-you-need-a-tb-test-to-enter-the-uk) and the [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide).

## About this programme

The Business Administration, Master of (MBA) is a full-time programme. It lasts 12 months and runs on campus in Edinburgh, in the Central Area. The programme holds three accreditations: AACSB, EQUIS and AMBA. For the wider picture, read our [University of Edinburgh](/study-abroad/universities/university-of-edinburgh) page.

From September to March, every student takes 12 compulsory courses. They cover topics such as strategic leadership, finance, strategic marketing and operations improvement. From April, you choose electives. The MBA with International Exchange adds 2 to 3 months at one of the university's partner universities.

The most important rule for Indian applicants is work experience. You need at least three years in a managerial role. Managing can mean responsibility for a project, a team or tasks. You do not need the job title "manager".

## Can you get in?

**Degree.** You need a UK 2:1 honours degree in any subject, or an equivalent overseas qualification. For an Indian degree, check how the University rates your marks on its India entry requirements page before you apply.

**GMAT.** The GMAT is a business school admissions test. It is not compulsory for this MBA. The school may ask for it only if you do not meet the minimum academic requirement. If it does, the minimum score is 555, or 600 on the 10th Edition format.

**English.** IELTS (International English Language Testing System) is a test of English. You need an overall score of 7.0 on IELTS Academic, with at least 6.0 in each part. A skill retake is not accepted. These other tests are also accepted:

- TOEFL iBT, current version (from 21 January 2026): total 5.0, with at least 4.0 in each part. Earlier version: total 100, with at least 20 in each part.
- C1 Advanced or C2 Proficiency: total 185, with at least 169 in each part.
- Oxford ELLT: total 8, with at least 6 in each part.
- Oxford Test of English Advanced: total 155, with at least 135 in each part.

Your test must be no more than 2 years old. A degree taught in English in a majority-English-speaking country also counts.

**Selection.** After the second stage, you may be invited to an interview, in person or by online video. It covers your suitability and expectations.

## What it costs

- **Tuition: £47,680** for 2027/28 entry. The fee page lists this for the full-time MBA, and it is for one year only.
- **Tuition deposit: £2,500.** A deposit is an advance payment that counts towards your tuition. Pay it within 28 days of receiving your unconditional or conditional offer.
- **Application fee: none.** There is no fee to apply.
- **Living money for the visa.** Studying outside London, you must show £1,171 for each month of the course, up to 9 months. You must have held this money for 28 days in a row. The last day of that 28-day period must fall within 31 days of the day you apply.
- **Student visa fee: £558** when you apply from outside the UK.
- **Immigration Health Surcharge: £776 for each year of the visa.** This is the health fee you pay with your visa.

### Worked first-year total

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Tuition, 2027/28 | £47,680 |
| Living money: £1,171 a month x 9 months | £10,539 |
| Student visa fee (from outside the UK) | £558 |
| Immigration Health Surcharge | £1,164 |
| **Total** | **£59,941** |

The arithmetic: £47,680 + £10,539 + £558 + £1,164 = £59,941. The £2,500 deposit is part of your tuition, so it is not added again.

Your visa runs longer than your course. For a 12-month course it lasts about 17 months (1 month before the course and 4 months after). A visa of more than one year and up to 18 months pays the yearly £776 plus half of it, £388, so the surcharge is **£1,164**.

For other UK options, see the [UK total cost breakdown](/study-abroad/study-in/uk/uk-total-cost-breakdown).

## Funding

**India Merit Scholarship.** This award covers £5,000 towards tuition for the 2027/28 academic year. It is for the first year of study only. You may qualify if:

- you were domiciled in India when you applied,
- you pay international fees and are fully or partly self-funded,
- your Indian undergraduate degree meets the minimum grade in the scholarship's grade table. For the MBA, the minimums are 90% (100% scale), 9.5 (10-point CGPA), 7.5 (8-point CGPA), 6.6 (7-point CGPA) or 3.8 (4-point GPA),
- you join a full-time, on-campus taught master's course.

There is no separate application. Eligible students who accept an unconditional offer are awarded it automatically. Read the [India Merit Scholarship page](https://registryservices.ed.ac.uk/student-funding/postgraduate/international/region/asia/india-merit-scholarship) for the full terms.

**Graduate discount.** University of Edinburgh graduates get 10% off tuition. It is not open to students from India in general.

## Deadlines and intakes

| Round | Apply by | Decision by |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 14 Oct 2026 | 26 Nov 2026 |
| 2 | 25 Nov 2026 | 21 Jan 2027 |
| 3 | 27 Jan 2027 | 11 Mar 2027 |
| 4 | 3 Mar 2027 | 22 Apr 2027 |
| 5 | 21 Apr 2027 | 10 Jun 2027 |
| 6 | 9 Jun 2027 | 29 Jul 2027 |

These are the rounds for 2027/28 entry. Round 1 closed on 14 Oct 2026, so the next closing date is 25 Nov 2026 for Round 2. The school also makes offers to a few candidates on a rolling basis. The programme starts in mid-September, and the page also lists multiple start dates. Apply early: the earliest you can apply for the visa is 6 months before your course starts.

## How to apply

1. **Use the online portal.** Applications are accepted only through the online application portal, which you reach from the programme page. Select the award and duration, then the start date. The school cannot consider more than 5 applications from one applicant.
2. **Write a personal statement.** It is required.
3. **Send your CV and documents.** Submit a detailed CV, details of your knowledge or training, one professional reference, your English test evidence, and your degree certificates and transcripts. Add certified translations if they are not in English.
4. **Pay the deposit after your offer.** The £2,500 deposit is due within 28 days of your offer.
5. **Get your CAS.** A CAS (Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies) is the university's official confirmation that it has accepted you. Your visa application needs it.
6. **Apply for the visa.** You need your CAS, a valid passport and proof of money. The gov.uk guidance says a decision is usually within 3 weeks if you apply from outside the UK.

Two more visa checks. A TB test may be needed, because India is on the list of countries where it applies. It must be done at a Home Office approved clinic. Some courses need an ATAS certificate. Ask the university whether yours does.

## After the programme

- **Careers support.** You get one-to-one MBA career consultations and a credit-bearing Professional Development course.
- **Final assignment.** Towards the end, you write a 7,500-word problem-solving assignment. It can follow a research, consultancy or business-plan pathway.
- **Careers.** The programme page says the MBA "can lead to a variety of specialised careers". Its examples run from chief strategy officer to senior procurement specialist.
- **Graduate visa.** The Graduate visa is the post-study work visa. It lasts 2 years if you apply on or before 31 December 2026, and 18 months if you apply on or after 1 January 2027. Because this programme starts in 2027, the 18-month rule applies. The application fee is £937. Read the [Graduate visa guide on gov.uk](https://www.gov.uk/graduate-visa).

## Who it suits

**A strong choice if:**

- you have at least three years in a managerial role,
- you can reach IELTS 7.0, with at least 6.0 in each part,
- you want a one-year, full-time MBA in Edinburgh with three accreditations,
- you want the option of 2 to 3 months on exchange,
- you may qualify for the £5,000 India Merit Scholarship.

**Think carefully if:**

- you do not yet have three years of managerial experience,
- you cannot show the first-year total of £59,941,
- you cannot pay the £2,500 deposit within 28 days of your offer.

## Sources

Checked on 3 November 2026: [MBA programme page](https://study.ed.ac.uk/programmes/postgraduate-taught/267-business-administration-master-of), [MBA fee page](https://study.ed.ac.uk/programmes/postgraduate-taught-campus-fees?programme_code=PTMBABUSAD5F&year=2027), [India Merit Scholarship](https://registryservices.ed.ac.uk/student-funding/postgraduate/international/region/asia/india-merit-scholarship), [Immigration Health Surcharge](https://www.gov.uk/healthcare-immigration-application/how-much-pay).

## About this programme

The Full Time MBA (Master of Business Administration) at Leeds University Business School is a one-year, full-time course. It runs on campus in Leeds and starts in September 2027. You study in English.

- Global Marketing Management
- People and Behaviour in Organizations
- Global Operations and Information Management
- Leading in Practice
- Strategic HRM and Talent Management
- Accounting and Finance

You also take part in Live Business Challenges, where teams work with industry professionals. On the International Study Tour, you work on a real consultancy project with an international organisation.

## Can you get in?

|---|---|
| Degree | A good bachelor's degree, equal to a UK 2:1 honours degree, or an acceptable professional qualification |
| Indian degree | To meet a 2:1, Leeds' India page lists first class (60%) or a CGPA of 6/10, 5/8, 4.2/7 or 3/4 |
| Work experience | More than three years of postgraduate work experience before you apply |
| GMAT | Not mandatory in most cases. Leeds may ask for GMAT Focus with a minimum score of 555 if your degree is below a 2:1, or if you have no formal or professional qualification |
| English | IELTS 6.5 overall, with no less than 6.0 in each section |
| Interview | Mandatory. Only one interview attempt is offered |

**GMAT** is the Graduate Management Admission Test, a test for business school entry. **IELTS** is an English language test. If you already hold a qualification that proves your English, check the list of tests below first.

Leeds also accepts these English tests:

| Test | Minimum score |
|---|---|
| PTE Academic | 64, with at least 60 in each skill. PTE online is not accepted |
| Cambridge Advanced (CAE) | Grade C or above |
| TOEFL iBT | 88, with 19 in listening, 20 in reading, 22 in speaking and 21 in writing. The Home Edition is not accepted |
| LanguageCert Academic | 70, with 65 in each skill. Online tests are not accepted |

You must have had enough money for 28 days in a row, and the last day of that period must be within 31 days of the day you apply. The [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide) explains the full process.

**Deposit.** A deposit is a payment you make in advance, and it is taken off your tuition. The £2,000 deposit is a general taught-masters rule. It does not name the MBA. Taught postgraduate applicants who need a Student visa pay it after an unconditional offer, and before they receive a CAS. A CAS (Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies) is the document Leeds issues so you can apply for your visa. The deadline for this deposit for taught postgraduate applicants is 20 August 2027.

The MBA Excellence Scholarships are the scholarship for this programme. The award is a tuition fee deduction. Leeds does not give one fixed amount. All applicants are considered automatically. Leeds judges applicants on career achievement, academic record and leadership, with community values. It assesses you from your application form and your interview. Leeds lists the final deadline as ongoing. Questions go to mba@lubs.leeds.ac.uk.

Two Masters scholarships do not cover the MBA. The Masters International Excellence Scholarship excludes the MBA. The Masters International Regional Scholarship, which gives a £6,000 fee reduction to passport holders from India and other listed countries, also excludes it.

For more on fees and funding at Leeds, see our [University of Leeds page](/study-abroad/universities/university-of-leeds).

## Deadlines and intakes

Start: September 2027.

| Intake | Who applies | Apply by |
|---|---|---|
| September 2027 | International applicants | 31 July 2027 |
| September 2027 | UK applicants | 14 August 2027 |

Any conditions on your offer must be met by 6 August 2027, 23:59 UK time. The interview takes place before a conditional offer, so plan for it early.

Apply early for your visa. The earliest you can apply for a Student visa is 6 months before your course starts.

## How to apply

1. Check the entry rules above. Look at your degree, your work experience, your English test and whether you may need a GMAT score.
2. Apply online through the University of Leeds Applicant Portal. This is the only application route. For questions, email mba@lubs.leeds.ac.uk.
3. Gather your documents:
   - a completed application form
   - an up-to-date CV that shows your work experience
   - original transcripts and certificates, with certified translations if they are not in English
   - evidence of your English test, which you can send before you take the test
   - a copy of your passport, showing the number and expiry date
   - your UK visa history, if you have one
   - your GMAT score report, if you have taken the test
4. Write a personal statement of no more than 200 words. It answers three questions: a fun fact about you, a lecture topic for MBA students, and your greatest career achievement.
5. Ask for two references: one academic and one from an employer.
6. Attend the interview. It is mandatory, and only one attempt is offered.

The [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide) covers the Student visa route and what follows it.

## About this programme

The MBA at the University of Sheffield is a one-year, full-time programme. Sheffield University Management School runs it. The next intake starts in September 2027. Teaching takes place in a dedicated MBA executive suite on the Sheffield campus.

The course is accredited by the Association of MBAs, EQUIS, AACSB and the Chartered Management Institute (CMI).

The university says a selection of modules is available each year. Examples include Leading People and Transforming Organisations, Global Managerial Economics, and Accounting and Corporate Finance. There are also several named challenges, including the Sheffield MBA Challenge and an AI, Analytics and Digital Technologies Challenge.

You apply what you learn to live projects with real clients, from local start-ups to global multinationals. The course also includes a 3-day study visit to Mannheim Business School and Frankfurt, and a London Career Safari.

**The most important rule for you:** you need at least three years of full-time postgraduate work experience. A good degree is not enough on its own.

## Can you get in?

**Your degree.** You need a minimum 2.2 undergraduate honours degree. A 2.2 is a lower second-class honours degree. Sheffield's India entry page lists 55% as the equivalent of a 2:2 (Lower Second Class Honours).

**Your work experience.** You need at least three years of full-time postgraduate work experience. The course page sets this as an entry requirement.

**Your English.** The university asks for IELTS 6.5 overall, with 6 in each component. IELTS (International English Language Testing System) is an English test. Other English qualifications are also accepted. See the [university's English language page](https://sheffield.ac.uk/postgraduate/english-language).

**Your interview.** Every application is reviewed. Successful applicants are invited to an online interview. Attending an interview is a requirement of the MBA admissions process.

**If you do not meet the entry rules.** The course page says that if you do not meet the entry requirements, you can study a Pre-Masters in Business, Social Sciences and Humanities at University of Sheffield International College first.

## What it costs

**Tuition.** For 2027-28 entry, the overseas tuition fee is **£37,630**. The course is one year long, so this is the fee for the whole programme. The university has a fixed fee guarantee in place for postgraduate taught overseas students.

**Application fee.** There is no application fee for postgraduate taught master's programmes.

**Tuition deposit.** After you accept an unconditional offer (an offer with no conditions left to meet), the university normally asks you to pay a deposit on your tuition fee. A deposit is an advance payment towards your tuition. Your offer letter gives the amount and the due date.

**Optional study trip.** If you join the international study trip, you pay a **£100** non-refundable deposit. Non-refundable means you do not get it back.

**Living money for the visa.** You must show that you can pay for your living costs. Sheffield is outside London, so the rate is **£1,171 a month** for up to **9 months**. The money must have been available for **28 days in a row**. The end of that 28-day period must be within 31 days of the date you apply.

**CAS.** A Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies (CAS) is issued by your course provider once you are accepted. You need it for your visa application.

**Visa fee and health surcharge.** The student visa application fee from outside the UK is **£558**. The Immigration Health Surcharge is **£776 for each year** of your visa.

### Worked first-year total

This is an example, not a budget.

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Tuition, MBA (2027-28, overseas) | £37,630 |
| Living money: £1,171 × 9 months | £10,539 |
| Visa application fee | £558 |
| Immigration Health Surcharge, one year | £1,164 |
| **Total** | **£49,891** |

The sum is £37,630 + £10,539 + £558 + £1,164 = £49,891. The surcharge is £1,164.

Your visa runs longer than your course. For a 12-month course it lasts about 17 months (1 month before the course and 4 months after). A visa of more than one year and up to 18 months pays the yearly £776 plus half of it, £388, so the surcharge is **£1,164**. That is £776 plus half of £776 (£388).

Read the rules in our [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide). To compare total costs across UK universities, use the [UK total cost breakdown](/study-abroad/study-in/uk/uk-total-cost-breakdown).

## Funding

There are two main awards for this programme. They cannot be combined.

**Sheffield MBA Scholarship Scheme.** This gives **50%** of the tuition fee, awarded on a competitive basis. It is for the MBA only. You do not make a separate application. At the listed fee of £37,630, 50% is £18,815. It is a tuition discount, not cash.

To be considered, you must hold an unconditional or conditional offer. You must be self-funding, so sponsored students cannot apply. You must start in Autumn 2027. The university awards scholarships throughout the year.

**International Postgraduate Scholarship 2027.** This is a **£7,000** tuition fee reduction for students from selected countries. India is on the list. You do not apply for it separately. You must:

- be a full-time, self-funded student with overseas fee status
- be a permanent resident of, or have lived in, India for the last 3 years
- accept your offer by 4pm UK time on Tuesday 6 July 2027

**Only one award.** You cannot combine the 50% MBA scholarship with the £7,000 scholarship. If you are selected for more than one scholarship, the most valuable award takes precedence.

**Alumni discount.** If you already hold a Sheffield degree, you can get up to £2,500 off your tuition fees.

## Deadlines and intakes

| Item | Date |
|---|---|
| Intake | September 2027 only |
| Closing date for September 2027 entry | Friday 3 September 2027, 17:00 British Summer Time |
| Last date to apply if you need a UK student visa | Thursday 26 August 2027 |
| Accept an International Postgraduate Scholarship offer | Tuesday 6 July 2027, 4pm UK time |

The closing date is the university's date for all postgraduate taught courses starting in September 2027.

Apply early, because visa timing matters. The earliest you can apply for a visa is 6 months before your course starts. The government says a decision usually takes 3 weeks if you apply from outside the UK.

## How to apply

There is no application fee. Follow these steps.

1. Check the entry rules above: a 2.2 degree, at least three years of full-time postgraduate work experience, and IELTS 6.5 with 6 in each component.
2. Start your application on the university's **Postgraduate Online Application Form**, from the [MBA course page](https://sheffield.ac.uk/postgraduate/taught/courses/2027/mba-master-business-administration-mba).
3. Upload your supporting statement. It answers four questions, with 200 words for each question.
4. Upload an up-to-date CV. You do not need references.
5. Wait for the initial review by the MBA admissions team.
6. If you are shortlisted, attend the online interview.
7. Accept your offer. If you hold an unconditional offer, pay the tuition deposit by the date in your offer letter.
8. If you need a visa, ask your course provider for your CAS and apply for the visa. See the [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide).

## After the programme

- The university says its MBA graduates work across a wide range of industries and job roles around the world.
- You get one-to-one support from a Careers and Employability Consultant, and you join the university's alumni network.
- After a UK course, you can apply for the Graduate visa. It lasts 2 years if you apply on or before 31 December 2026. It lasts 18 months if you apply on or after 1 January 2027. The application fee is £937.

## Who it suits

**A strong choice if:**

- you have a 2.2 degree or better and at least three years of full-time postgraduate work experience
- you want a one-year, full-time MBA with live projects for real clients
- you are self-funding, can show £1,171 a month for 9 months, and can pay the £558 visa fee and the £776 a year health surcharge
- you want to be considered for the 50% scholarship

**Think carefully if:**

- you have less than three years of full-time postgraduate work experience
- your IELTS is below 6.5 overall, or below 6 in any component
- you are sponsored, because the 50% scholarship is only for self-funded students
- you need a visa and would apply after Thursday 26 August 2027

## About this programme

The MBA (Master of Business Administration) is a full-time course at Southampton Business School. It lasts 1 year, from September to the following September. You study at the Boldrewood campus in Southampton.

The course runs in three stages. Semester 1, Mastering fundamentals, includes a European study trip. Semester 2, Mastering complexity, includes a live consultancy project in an emerging market country. The summer stage is a research project. You can also do a business project with a real client.

Core modules include Accounting, Corporate Finance, Operations Management, and Strategy and Decision Making. Optional modules include Project Management, Strategic Brand Management and International Banking.

The course page names two accreditation bodies: AMBA and AACSB.

**The most important thing for you:** the MBA asks for 3 years of professional experience supervising or managing people.

For the wider picture, read our [University of Southampton page](/study-abroad/universities/university-of-southampton).

## Can you get in?

The typical offer is a 2:2 degree. A 2:2 is the lower second-class honours grade in the UK. Southampton converts Indian grades by the tier of your university. For a 2:2, the Indian grade needed is:

| Your university's tier | Indian grade for a 2:2 |
|---|---|
| Tier 1 | 55% |
| Tier 2 | 60% |
| Tier 3 | 65% |

The university's India entry page shows which tier applies to your university.

If you do not have a first degree, Southampton will consider your application if you have professional qualifications or 8 years of experience in management.

You need 3 years of professional experience supervising or managing people. Some analytical experience will strengthen your application, but it is not a requirement.

**Your application.** You write a personal statement. It explains why you want the MBA, what you know about the subject, and your career plans after the course. You also submit two references, which can be professional or academic. The university invites all suitable applicants to an interview. If you live abroad, the interview is by phone.

**English.** IELTS (International English Language Testing System) is a test of English. You need an overall score of 6.5, with 6.0 in reading, writing, speaking and listening. Other English tests are accepted, and the university lists them on its English requirements page. If you do not meet the score, you may be able to meet it by completing one of the university's pre-sessional English programmes.

The UK student visa also needs English at CEFR B2 level. CEFR is a common scale for language levels. B2 is the level the visa requires for degree study.

Tuition is **GBP 37,400** for the year. International students pay the same as UK students. The fee includes two international trips: a study trip and a live consultancy project. Travel and visa costs are not included.

**Deposit.** You pay a **GBP 2,000** deposit in advance. A deposit is an early payment. This one is part of your tuition, so it is not an extra cost. The offer letter tells you when it is due.

**CAS.** A CAS (Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies) is the document your course provider issues for your visa. You must have one to apply.

**Living money.** Living money is the money you must show to pay for your living costs during the visa. Southampton is outside London, so you must show **GBP 1,171** for each month of your course, for up to 9 months. You must have had this money for 28 days in a row. The last day of that 28-day period must be within 31 days of the day you apply.

**Visa and health fees.** The Student visa fee from outside the UK is **GBP 558**. The Immigration Health Surcharge is **GBP 776** for each year of your visa.

## Funding

**Dean's MBA Global Talent Award.** This reduces your fee by between GBP 17,000 and GBP 25,000. Up to 11 awards are given in three rounds.

| Round | Awards | Apply by |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 3 awards of GBP 25,000 | 28 November 2026, 5pm UK time |
| 2 | 5 awards of GBP 20,000 | 1 March 2027, 5pm UK time |
| 3 | 3 awards of GBP 17,000 | 29 May 2027, 5pm UK time |

You must be self-funded and a permanent resident of an eligible country. India is on the list. The application includes a 500-word supporting statement and an interview. The university cannot accept late applications.

**AMBA and BGA Diamond Scholarship.** This gives 50% off tuition, worth GBP 18,500. The application includes a 500-word statement on five Diamond criteria, and an interview. Apply by **31 December 2026, 6pm UK time**.

If you win more than one Southampton scholarship, you automatically get the highest-value award.

**Alumni.** If you graduated from Southampton, you could be eligible for a 10% discount on postgraduate tuition fees.

## Deadlines and intakes

|---|---|
| September 2027 | Wednesday 4 August 2027, midday UK time |

The university warns that applications may close early, so apply as early as you can. The university aims to send you a decision 6 weeks after you submit.

Apply for your visa early too. You can apply for a student visa up to 6 months before your course starts. From outside the UK, gov.uk says a decision usually comes within 3 weeks.

## How to apply

1. Click the blue Apply for this course button on the course page. It takes you to the university's postgraduate admissions system.
2. Create an account, search for the course, and complete the form.
3. Upload your personal statement, your first degree paperwork and your IELTS score. Submit your two references.
4. Submit before the deadline. There is no application fee for courses starting in 2027.
5. Attend your interview if you are invited. Applicants abroad are interviewed by phone.
6. If you are offered a place, pay the GBP 2,000 deposit by the date in your offer letter.
7. Apply for your student visa with your CAS, your proof of living money and, if you need one, your TB (tuberculosis) test results. India is on the government's TB test list. You need the test if all three of these apply: you are coming to the UK for 6 months or more; you have lived in a listed country for 6 months or more; and you were living there within the last 6 months. The test must be done at a Home Office approved clinic. Follow each step in our [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide).

## After the programme

Graduates commonly work in a range of organisations or sectors, including consultancy, technology, business and finance.

The Graduate visa lets you work in the UK after your course. It lasts 2 years if you apply on or before 31 December 2026. It lasts 18 months if you apply on or after 1 January 2027. The application fee is GBP 937. Your course ends in September 2028, so you will apply after 1 January 2027.

- You have 3 years or more of experience supervising or managing people.

- You have a 2:2 degree, or the Indian grade equivalent for your university's tier.
- You can show GBP 1,171 a month of living money for up to 9 months.

- You have less than 3 years of experience supervising or managing people.
