## At a glance

The University of Sheffield teaches its master's courses on one main campus in Sheffield. This page covers three one-year courses: MSc Computer Science, MSc Data Science and the MBA.

The most important number is tuition. For 2027-28 entry, overseas tuition for MSc Computer Science is **£34,550 a year**. There is no application fee, and the **£7,000** scholarship in the section below may lower your fee.

| | MSc Computer Science | MSc Data Science |
|---|---|---|
| Length | **1 year**, full-time | **1 year**, full-time |
| Start | September 2027 | September 2027 |
| Overseas tuition (2027-28) | **£34,550** a year | **£36,055** a year |
| Application fee | **None** | **None** |
| Degree needed | 2:1 in a non-computing subject | 2:1 in any subject |
| English test (IELTS) | **6.5** overall, **6** in each part | **6.5** overall, **6** in each part |
| Deadline for September 2027 | **Friday 3 September 2027**, 17:00 British Summer Time | Same |

## What it really costs

Tuition is the biggest cost. Sheffield's course pages list these fees for overseas students:

- MSc Computer Science: **£34,550** a year
- MSc Data Science: **£36,055** a year

The Computer Science and Data Science pages say the university has a fixed fee guarantee in place for overseas postgraduate taught students. For the MBA fee, see the [MBA course page](https://sheffield.ac.uk/postgraduate/taught/courses/2027/mba-master-business-administration-mba).

**Deposit.** After you accept an unconditional offer (an offer with no conditions left to meet), the university normally asks you to pay a deposit on your tuition fee. A deposit is an advance payment towards your tuition. Your offer letter gives the amount and the date.

**Living money for the visa.** For the UK student visa, you must show that you can pay for your living costs. Sheffield is outside London, so the amount is **£1,171 a month** for up to **9 months**. The money must have been available for 28 days in a row.

**CAS.** A Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies (CAS) is issued by your course provider once you are accepted. You need it for your visa application.

**Visa fee and health surcharge.** The student visa application fee from outside the UK is **£558**. The Immigration Health Surcharge (IHS) is charged for students at **£776 for each year of your visa**.

### Worked first-year cost: MSc Computer Science

This is an example, not a budget. It uses full-rate tuition and the living money for 9 months.

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Tuition, MSc Computer Science (2027-28) | £34,550 |
| Living money: £1,171 × 9 months | £10,539 |
| Visa application fee | £558 |
| Immigration Health Surcharge, for your visa | £1,164 |
| **Total** | **£46,811** |

Your visa runs longer than your course. For a 12-month course it lasts about 17 months (1 month before the course and 4 months after). A visa of more than one year and up to 18 months pays the yearly £776 plus half of it, £388, so the surcharge is **£1,164**.

The sum with one year of surcharge is £34,550 + £10,539 + £558 + £1,164 = £46,811. If the £7,000 scholarship applies, tuition falls to £27,550 (£34,550 − £7,000), and the total becomes £39,811 (£27,550 + £10,539 + £558 + £1,164).

Read the rules in our [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide). To compare total costs across UK universities, use the [UK total cost breakdown](/study-abroad/study-in/uk/uk-total-cost-breakdown).

## Ways to reduce the cost

**International Postgraduate Scholarship 2027.** This is a **£7,000** tuition fee reduction for students from selected countries, and India is on the list. You do not apply for it separately. You must:

- be full-time, self-funded, with overseas fee status
- be a permanent resident of, or have lived in, India for the last three years
- accept your offer by 4pm UK time on Tuesday 6 July 2027

**Sheffield MBA Scholarship Scheme.** This gives **50%** of the MBA tuition fee, awarded on a competitive basis. All MBA offer holders are considered, so you do not apply separately. It is not for sponsored students and cannot be combined with other University scholarships. Your offer letter gives the deposit deadline.

**Alumni discount.** If you already hold a Sheffield degree, you can get up to **£2,500** off tuition. This is not a general discount for all students.

**Only one award.** The £7,000 scholarship cannot be combined with any other University scholarship or discount, unless the University says so. If you qualify for more than one, the higher award takes precedence.

## Getting in

A 2:1 is an upper second-class honours degree, and a 2.2 is a lower second-class honours degree.

- **MSc Computer Science** asks for a 2:1 honours degree in a non-computing subject. It is a conversion course for people from other subjects, and no coding is needed.
- **MSc Data Science** asks for a 2:1 honours degree in any subject.
- **MBA** asks for a 2.2 honours degree, plus at least three years of full-time postgraduate work experience.

For Indian degrees, Sheffield's India page gives these equivalents:

| UK grade | Percentage on an Indian degree |
|---|---|
| First class honours | 65% |
| 2:1 | 60% |
| 2:2 | 55% |

**English.** IELTS is an English language test. All three courses ask for **IELTS 6.5** overall, with **6** in each part. For the visa, you need English at CEFR level B2 for degree study. CEFR is a standard scale for language levels.

## Deadlines

| Item | Date |
|---|---|
| September 2027 applications, all three courses | Friday 3 September 2027, 17:00 British Summer Time |
| Last date to apply if you need a student visa | Thursday 26 August 2027 |
| Accept an International Postgraduate Scholarship offer | Tuesday 6 July 2027, 4pm UK time |

Apply early, because visa timing matters. You can apply for a student visa up to 6 months before your course starts. gov.uk says a decision usually takes 3 weeks when you apply from outside the UK.

Two other checks can take time:

- **ATAS** (Academic Technology Approval Scheme) is a certificate some courses need. If your course needs one, gov.uk says it takes at least 30 working days (6 weeks) to process. Indian nationals are not on the list of exempt nationalities, so check whether your course needs it. You must have it before you start the course.
- **TB test:** India is on the list of countries where you may need a tuberculosis (TB) test. The test must be done at a clinic approved by the Home Office.

## The courses covered here

- [MSc Computer Science](https://sheffield.ac.uk/postgraduate/taught/courses/2027/computer-science-msc): one year, full-time. Aimed at graduates of non-computing subjects who want to move into computing.
- [MSc Data Science](https://sheffield.ac.uk/postgraduate/taught/courses/2027/data-science-msc): one year full-time. A two-year part-time option is also listed.
- [MBA](https://sheffield.ac.uk/postgraduate/taught/courses/2027/mba-master-business-administration-mba): one year, full-time. Entry requires postgraduate work experience.

## Where you'll live

Sheffield's courses are taught at the main campus on Western Bank in Sheffield. The MBA is taught on the Sheffield campus too.

The university's rents page lists these postgraduate rates for 2026/27:

These are 2026/27 rates, not 2027/28 rates. Check the rents page again before you plan your budget.

## Who it's a good fit for

**A strong choice if:**

- you have a 2:1 in a non-computing subject and want a one-year route into computing
- you have a 2:1 in any subject and want a one-year data science master's
- you have at least three years of full-time postgraduate work experience and want to be considered for the 50% MBA scholarship
- you can show £1,171 a month for 9 months, and pay the £558 visa fee and the health surcharge at £776 for each year of your visa

**Think carefully if:**

- your degree is a 2:2. The MBA accepts a 2.2, but MSc Computer Science and MSc Data Science need a 2:1
- you cannot reach IELTS 6.5 with 6 in each part
- you need a visa and would apply after Thursday 26 August 2027
- you plan to use the alumni discount with the £7,000 scholarship, because the two cannot be combined

- have a conditional or unconditional offer.
- exceed the entry requirements.

faq_json.q: How much money do I need to show for the UK student visa for Southampton?
faq_json.a: If you study outside London, you must show £1,171 for each month of your course, for up to 9 months. For 9 months that is £10,539. You must have had this money for 28 days in a row.

fields.body_md:
## At a glance

The University of Nottingham is a public university. Its School of Computer Science and its Business School are based on Jubilee Campus. For most families the key fact is cost. The MSc Advanced Computer Science has an international fee of **£34,800** for a 12-month, full-time course that starts in **September 2027**.

| | MSc Advanced Computer Science | MSc Data Science | MBA |
|---|---|---|---|
| Length | 12 months, full-time | 12 months, full-time | 12 months, full-time |
| Start | September 2027 | September 2027 | September 2027 |
| International fee | **£34,800** | **£34,800** | **£34,800** |
| IELTS (English test) | 6.5 overall, 6.0 in each part | 6.5 overall, 6.0 in each part | 7.0 overall, 6.0 in each part |

## What it really costs

**Tuition.** The international fee is **£34,800** for each of the three courses. The MSc Advanced Computer Science runs for 12 months.

**Deposit.** For courses starting from August 2026 onwards, you pay a **£4,500 deposit** as part of the visa process. A deposit is an advance payment that secures your place. The university waives it only if a recognised sponsor fully funds your study. Ask the university whether this deposit counts towards your tuition.

**Living money.** The UK student visa asks you to show you can pay for living costs. Outside London, you show **£1,171 a month** for up to **9 months**. That comes to **£10,539**. You must have this money for 28 days in a row. The last day of that 28-day period must fall within 31 days of your visa application.

**Visa fees.** The Student visa application fee from outside the UK is **£558**. You also pay the Immigration Health Surcharge, which is **£776 for each year of your visa** for students.

### Worked first-year cost: MSc Advanced Computer Science

This example is for a course outside London.

| Item | How it is worked out | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| Tuition (international fee) | Course fee | £34,800 |
| Living money for the visa | £1,171 × 9 months | £10,539 |
| Visa application fee | One application | £558 |
| Immigration Health Surcharge | £776 + £388 (a visa of about 17 months) | £1,164 |
| **Total** | | **£47,061** |

Your visa runs longer than your course. For a 12-month course it lasts about 17 months (1 month before the course and 4 months after). A visa of more than one year and up to 18 months pays the yearly £776 plus half of it, £388, so the surcharge is **£1,164**.

The visa rules count up to 9 months of living money, so a 12-month course is covered at 9 months. The £4,500 deposit is not in this total.

This is an example, not a budget. Read the steps in our [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide). Compare wider costs in the [UK total cost breakdown](/study-abroad/study-in/uk/uk-total-cost-breakdown).

## Ways to reduce the cost

Nottingham's **International Postgraduate Masters Scholarship** takes **£3,000** off your tuition fee. You do not need to apply for it. It is for self-funded international students who start a full-time taught master's in 2027. It does not apply to students on the Kaplan pathway. For a two-year master's, it covers only the first year's fees.

With the scholarship, MSc Advanced Computer Science tuition is £31,800 (£34,800 minus £3,000).

## Getting in

Each course asks for a **2:1** degree. A 2:1 is the UK grade for a good honours degree, called an upper second.

- **MSc Advanced Computer Science:** a 2:1 (or international equivalent) in Computer Science, or in a STEM or numerate subject with substantial computing content.
- **MSc Data Science:** a 2:1 (or international equivalent) with an affinity for programming and/or advanced statistics.
- **MBA:** a 2:1 (or international equivalent) in any subject, a minimum of three years of full-time work experience after your degree, and an interview.

**Indian degrees.** Nottingham's India country page sets grade thresholds in three tiers. Read the page to see which tier applies to your university.

| Tier | First class | 2:1 |
|---|---|---|
| Tier 1 | 70% | 60% |
| Tier 2 | 75% | 65% |
| Tier 3 | 80% | 70% |

**English.** IELTS (International English Language Testing System) is an English test. The two MSc courses ask for **IELTS 6.5** overall, with at least 6.0 in each part. The MBA asks for **IELTS 7.0** overall, with no part below 6.0.

**Application fee.** The apply page says some courses need an application fee. You cannot submit your application until you have paid it. Check the apply page for the amount.

### After your offer: the visa

- **CAS.** A CAS (Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies) is the document your course provider issues. You need it for your visa application.
- **ATAS.** Indian nationals are not exempt from ATAS (the Academic Technology Approval Scheme). If your course needs an ATAS certificate, you must get it before you start the course.
- **TB test.** India is on the government's list of countries that need a TB test. You need the test if all three of these apply: you are coming to the UK for 6 months or more, you have lived in a listed country for 6 months or more, and you were living in one within the last 6 months. The test must be done at a clinic approved by the Home Office.

## Deadlines

| Course | Start |
|---|---|
| MSc Advanced Computer Science | September 2027 |
| MSc Data Science | September 2027 |
| MBA | September 2027 |

The university has not yet published closing dates for September 2027 entry. Its rough guide for international applicants is to apply around six to seven weeks before the start date. That is a guide, not a fixed deadline.

Visa timing matters more than the university deadline. You can apply for a UK student visa up to 6 months before your course starts. The government says most decisions take up to 3 weeks if you apply from outside the UK. Apply as early as you can.

## Where you'll live

The School of Computer Science and the Business School are based on Jubilee Campus. The campus has student accommodation, a sports centre and a lake. University Park Campus is about 20 minutes' walk away. Nottingham city centre is 20 minutes by bus.

Check the university's accommodation pages for current room prices before you set your budget.

## Who it's a good fit for

**A strong choice if:**

- You have a Computer Science degree, or a STEM degree with substantial computing content, and you want a one-year master's.
- You can show the £1,171 a month the visa asks for, which is £10,539 over 9 months.
- You are self-funded and start in September 2027. The £3,000 scholarship then applies.

**Think carefully if:**

- You want the MBA but have less than three years of full-time work experience.
- Your degree grade is below the 2:1 level for your university's tier.
- Your budget cannot cover the first-year example of £47,061, which is before the scholarship.

If you want a related course, the same department lists a [Human Computer Interaction MSc](https://www.nottingham.ac.uk/pgstudy/course/taught/human-computer-interaction-msc) and a [Cyber Physical Systems MSc](https://www.nottingham.ac.uk/pgstudy/course/taught/cyberphysical-systems-msc). Check their own pages for fees and entry rules.

## Sources

Checked on 3 November 2026 for the university pages, and on 1 November 2026 for the gov.uk pages.

- [MSc Advanced Computer Science](https://www.nottingham.ac.uk/pgstudy/course/taught/computer-science-artificial-intelligence)
- [MSc Data Science](https://www.nottingham.ac.uk/pgstudy/course/taught/data-science-msc)
- [MBA](https://www.nottingham.ac.uk/pgstudy/course/taught/business-administration-mba)
- [Postgraduate fees](https://www.nottingham.ac.uk/pgstudy/fees/postgraduate-fees.aspx)
- [Apply online](https://www.nottingham.ac.uk/pgstudy/how-to-apply/apply-online.aspx)
- [International Postgraduate Masters Scholarship](https://www.nottingham.ac.uk/pgstudy/funding/international-postgraduate-scholarships)
- [India country information](https://www.nottingham.ac.uk/studywithus/international-applicants/country-info/countryinformation/india.aspx)
- gov.uk: [Student visa](https://www.gov.uk/student-visa), [Documents you must provide](https://www.gov.uk/student-visa/documents-you-must-provide), [Financial evidence](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/financial-evidence-for-student-and-child-student-route-applicants), [Immigration Health Surcharge](https://www.gov.uk/healthcare-immigration-application/how-much-pay), [ATAS](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/academic-technology-approval-scheme), [TB test](https://www.gov.uk/tb-test-visa)
- gov.uk: [Healthcare surcharge](https://www.gov.uk/healthcare-immigration-application/how-much-pay)

Fees and rules change. Always confirm on the university's own website before you pay or apply.

## At a glance

The University of Glasgow is in Glasgow, Scotland. Its one-year Master of Science (MSc) in Computing Science is taught at the Gilmorehill campus. Many Indian students look at Glasgow because it offers two scholarships for students from India.

The most important thing to know is the cost. Tuition for international students is **£34,815 a year**. Living money and visa fees come on top, so the first-year total is higher. The worked example below shows the full figure.

| | MSc Computing Science |
|---|---|
| Campus | Gilmorehill, Glasgow |
| Length | 12 months, full time |
| Start | September |
| Tuition for international and EU students | **£34,815** a year (2027-28 fee year) |
| Deposit to secure a place | **£2,000** |
| English test (IELTS) | **6.5** overall. Either Writing is **6.5** and no other part is below **6.0**, or Writing is **6.0** and every other part is **6.5** or higher |

## What it really costs

Tuition is **£34,815** for full-time study in the 2027-28 fee year.

**Deposit.** International and EU applicants pay a **£2,000** deposit to secure a place. The deposit terms are on the university's website. Read them to check when you must pay.

**Living money for the visa.** A UK Student visa needs proof that you can pay for your living costs. Outside London, you must show **£1,171** for each month of your course, for up to **9 months**. You must hold this money for 28 days in a row. The last day of that 28-day period must fall within 31 days of the day you apply.

**The CAS.** A CAS (Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies) is the document your university issues once it accepts you. You need it for your visa application.

**English for the visa.** The visa also needs English at CEFR level B2 for degree-level study. CEFR is the common scale for language ability, running from A1 to C2.

**The health surcharge.** The Immigration Health Surcharge (IHS) is a fee you pay with your visa so you can use the NHS, the UK's public health service. It is **£776 for each year of your visa** for students.

### Worked first-year cost: MSc Computing Science

| Item | How it is worked out | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| Tuition | Full-time fee, 2027-28 | £34,815 |
| Living money for the visa | £1,171 × 9 months | £10,539 |
| Student visa application fee | Applying from outside the UK | £558 |
| Immigration Health Surcharge | £776 + £388 (a visa of about 17 months) | £1,164 |
| **Total** | £34,815 + £10,539 + £558 + £1,164 | **£47,076** |

Your visa runs longer than your course. For a 12-month course it lasts about 17 months (1 month before the course and 4 months after). A visa of more than one year and up to 18 months pays the yearly £776 plus half of it, £388, so the surcharge is **£1,164**.

This is an example, not a full budget. The £2,000 deposit is not in this total.

For the visa rules in full, read our [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide). To compare costs with other UK universities, see the [UK total cost breakdown](/study-abroad/study-in/uk/uk-total-cost-breakdown).

## Ways to reduce the cost

Glasgow has two scholarships for students from India. You cannot use both.

**World Changers India Excellence Award**

- A **£12,500** tuition fee waiver for one year.
- Up to 12 awards for students from India.
- You need a UK first-class equivalent result. The page says this is typically 85% and above.
- You need an offer for September 2027, international fee status, and an Indian passport. You must be domiciled in India, which means India is your permanent home.
- The deadline is **31 March 2027 at 11:45 UK time**. Results come by 14 April 2027.
- The page says applications "will open shortly". Check the page for the application link.

**World Changers Glasgow Scholarship**

- A **£5,000** tuition fee discount.
- It is applied automatically, so you do not apply separately.
- India is on the list of eligible countries.
- You need international fee status and an offer for September 2027 or January 2028.

**The two cannot be combined.** The World Changers Glasgow page says the scholarship "cannot be combined with another University scholarship". The India Excellence Award page says Glasgow discounts cannot be combined with one another, except the Alumni Discount. If you are offered more than one, the lower award is removed. In practice, plan for one of these two awards, not both.

## Getting in

- **Degree.** The course page asks for a 2.1 Honours degree or a non-UK equivalent, in any degree with Computing as a major subject. A 2.1 is a UK upper second-class degree. Ask the university how your Indian marks convert to a 2.1 before you apply.
- **English.** IELTS is an English test with four parts: listening, reading, writing and speaking. You need **6.5** overall. Either Writing is **6.5** and no other part is below **6.0**, or Writing is **6.0** and every other part is **6.5** or higher.

Check the course page for the full entry rules before you apply.

## Deadlines

For September 2027 entry, international applicants apply in rounds.

| Round | Opens | Closes |
|---|---|---|
| Round 1 | 1 Oct 2026 | 5 Nov 2026 |
| Round 2 | 6 Nov 2026 | 17 Dec 2026 |
| Round 3 | 18 Dec 2026 | 4 Feb 2027 |
| Round 4 | 5 Feb 2027 | 25 Mar 2027 |
| Round 5 | 26 Mar 2027 | 13 May 2027 |
| Round 6 | 14 May 2027 | 8 July 2027 |

The last round closes on **8 July 2027**. The MBA closes on **31 July 2027** for all applicants.

Apply early. You can apply for the visa no earlier than 6 months before your course starts. Plan your visa dates around your offer and your CAS.

## Related master's courses

The MSc Computing Science is the main course on this page. Two other Glasgow master's are close to it.

- [MSc Data Science and Artificial Intelligence](https://www.gla.ac.uk/postgraduate/taught/data-science-artificial-intelligence/) uses the same international rounds and the same IELTS rule as Computing Science.
- [MBA](https://www.gla.ac.uk/postgraduate/taught/businessadministration/) is a 12-month full-time course. It asks for IELTS 6.5 overall, with no part below 6.0.

## Where you will live

The course is taught at the Gilmorehill campus in Glasgow. Glasgow is the city where you will live while you study.

The university's postgraduate rooms cost from **£141.47 a week** for a Student Apartments twin shared room, up to **£258.72 a week** for a Kelvingrove House studio. These are **2026-27** rates for non-family postgraduate rooms. For 2027-28 prices, check the accommodation fees page.

The university's postgraduate guarantee for offer holders is stated for September 2026 entry. For September 2027, ask the accommodation office. To be told when applications open for session 2027/2028, sign up on the accommodation pages.

## Who it suits

**A strong choice if:**

- You have a 2.1 Honours degree with Computing as a major subject, or expect one, and can reach IELTS 6.5 overall with the Writing and other part scores the course asks for.
- You want a 12-month full-time MSc in Computing Science that starts in September.
- You can meet the first-class requirement for the India Excellence Award, or the international fee status for the Glasgow scholarship.

**Think carefully if:**

- You cannot show £1,171 a month for up to 9 months, held for 28 days in a row.
- Your Writing score is 6.0. That is allowed only if every other IELTS part is 6.5 or higher.
- You need more funding than one scholarship can give. Check the full cost before you apply.

To compare alternatives, see the [UK total cost breakdown](/study-abroad/study-in/uk/uk-total-cost-breakdown).

fields.body_md:
## At a glance

UCL (University College London) teaches its master's courses in central London. This page uses its one-year MSc Computer Science for the worked costs and entry rules, and mentions the other three master's courses it offers.

The most important thing to know is the cost. Tuition for MSc Computer Science is **£44,400 a year** for 2027/28. Once you add the visa money and visa fees you must show, the first year comes to **£59,883**.

| | MSc Computer Science |
|---|---|
| Campus | Bloomsbury, London |
| Tuition for international students, 2027/28 | **£44,400** a year |
| Length | 1 calendar year, full time |
| Start | September 2027 |
| Application fee | £90 for online applications |
| English test (IELTS) | 7.0 overall, with at least 6.5 in each part |

## What it really costs

Your costs fall into three groups: tuition, the fee deposit, and the money and fees for the visa.

**Tuition.** Tuition for international students is charged per year.

| Course | Tuition per year, 2027/28 |
|---|---|
| MSc Computer Science | £44,400 |
| MSc Data Science | £48,600 |
| MSc Management | £44,400 |
| MBA | See the fees note on the course page |

**Fee deposit.** UCL charges overseas offer holders a fee deposit of 10% of the first-year fee. Check the amount and when it is due on UCL's website.

**Visa money.** For the UK student visa you must show you can pay for your living costs. This is called proof of funds. For a course in London, the rule is £1,529 for each month of your course, up to 9 months. The rules count a maximum of 9 months, so the example below uses 9. You must have had this money for 28 days in a row, and the last day of that 28-day period must be within 31 days of the day you apply. This money is not a fee paid to UCL.

**Visa and health fees.** The Student visa costs £558 if you apply from outside the UK. You also pay the Immigration Health Surcharge (IHS), which is £776 for each year of your visa for students. It gives you access to the NHS while you study.

**Worked first-year cost: MSc Computer Science**

| Item | Calculation | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| Tuition, 2027/28 | Fixed fee | £44,400 |
| Visa money, London | £1,529 × 9 months | £13,761 |
| Student visa fee | Fixed fee | £558 |
| Immigration Health Surcharge | £776 + £388 (a visa of about 17 months) | £1,164 |
| **Total for the first year** | £44,400 + £13,761 + £558 + £1,164 | **£59,883** |

Your visa runs longer than your course. For a 12-month course it lasts about 17 months (1 month before the course and 4 months after). A visa of more than one year and up to 18 months pays the yearly £776 plus half of it, £388, so the surcharge is **£1,164**.

This is an example, not a budget. It does not include the fee deposit, flights or personal spending.

Read the full rules in our [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide). To compare these costs with other UK universities, see the [UK total cost breakdown](/study-abroad/study-in/uk/uk-total-cost-breakdown).

## Ways to reduce the cost

- **Chevening.** Chevening is a UK government scholarship. It covers full tuition and a living allowance for Master's degrees taught by UCL Computer Science. The 2027/28 round is closed. The next application window is August to October 2027. Read the [UCL scholarship page](https://www.ucl.ac.uk/engineering/computer-science/study/scholarships/postgraduate-taught-scholarships) before you apply.
- **UCL Global Master's.** This is a £15,000 award for international students from low-income backgrounds. It is open to all postgraduate taught courses. The page says applications are closed for 2026.

## Getting in

Each course sets its own degree and English rules.

| Course | Degree needed | IELTS (overall, and minimum in each part) |
|---|---|---|
| MSc Computer Science | Upper second-class (2:1) UK Bachelor's degree, or equivalent | 7.0, with at least 6.5 in each part |
| MSc Data Science | Upper second-class Bachelor's degree in a quantitative discipline | 6.5, with at least 6.0 in each part |
| MSc Management | Upper second-class (2:1) UK Bachelor's degree, or overseas equivalent | 7.0, with at least 6.5 in each part |
| MBA | Lower second-class degree in a relevant discipline, plus at least three years of full-time work experience, plus GMAT or GRE (or equivalent) | 6.5, with at least 6.0 in each part |

**Indian degrees.** UCL's India entry page lists the 2:1 equivalent as "CGPA of 7.5/10, 6.0/8.0, 5.5/7.0, 4.0/6.0, 3.0/4.0 or 60%". The figure that applies depends on how your university is ranked. Check the [India entry page](https://www.ucl.ac.uk/study/international/region/south-asia/india) for your case.

**English.** IELTS (International English Language Testing System) is an English test. UCL sets an overall score and a minimum score for each part. For MSc Computer Science, the course is set at Level 2, which means an overall 7.0 with at least 6.5 in each part.

## Deadlines

Applications open on 19 October 2026 for all four courses. Each course starts in September 2027.

| Course | Closes if you need a visa | Closes if you do not need a visa |
|---|---|---|
| MSc Computer Science | 22 March 2027, 5pm UK time | 27 August 2027, 10am UK time |
| MSc Data Science | 22 March 2027, 5pm UK time | 27 August 2027, 5pm UK time |
| MSc Management | 25 June 2027, 5pm UK time | 27 August 2027, 5pm UK time |
| MBA | 22 March 2027, 5pm UK time | 27 August 2027, 5pm UK time |

Most Indian students need a visa, so the first column is the one to plan around. Apply early. You can apply for the student visa up to 6 months before the course starts.

Once UCL offers you a place, it issues a CAS, which stands for Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies. You need a CAS to apply for the visa. Other visa papers include your passport, proof of funds and a TB test if you need one. India is on the UK's list of countries where a TB (tuberculosis) test may be needed. Check the [gov.uk TB test page](https://www.gov.uk/tb-test-visa), because the rule depends on how long you have lived in India and how long you plan to stay in the UK.

Some courses also need an Academic Technology Approval Scheme (ATAS) certificate. If your course needs one, you must get it before you start. See the [gov.uk ATAS guide](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/academic-technology-approval-scheme).

## Popular programs for Indian students

This page covers four UCL master's courses.

- **MSc Computer Science.** One calendar year, full time, at Bloomsbury in London. Tuition is £44,400 a year. [Course page](https://www.ucl.ac.uk/study/prospective-students/graduate/courses/computer-science-msc).
- **MSc Data Science.** One calendar year, full time, at Bloomsbury in London. Tuition is £48,600 a year. [Course page](https://www.ucl.ac.uk/study/prospective-students/graduate/courses/data-science-msc).
- **MSc Management.** One calendar year, full time, at Canary Wharf in London. Tuition is £44,400 a year. [Course page](https://www.ucl.ac.uk/study/prospective-students/graduate/courses/management-msc).
- **MBA.** Runs for 16 months, full time. You need at least three years of full-time work experience and a GMAT or GRE score. [Course page](https://www.ucl.ac.uk/study/prospective-students/graduate/courses/business-administration-mba).

## Where you'll live

The Computer Science and Data Science courses are based at Bloomsbury, in central London. The Management MSc is based at Canary Wharf. The MBA lists Peking University in Beijing, China as its location, with an optional module in London at Canary Wharf.
UCL says that first-year full-time international postgraduates are prioritised for a place in halls, as long as they apply before the deadline. This is priority, not a guaranteed place. Read the [postgraduate accommodation guide](https://www.ucl.ac.uk/study/accommodation/how-apply-accommodation/how-apply-postgraduates) for the steps and the deadline. Check current room prices on UCL's accommodation pages before you plan your budget.

## Who it's a good fit for

**A strong choice if:**

- you want a one-year master's in central London
- you hold, or will hold, an upper second-class degree, or the India equivalent shown above
- you can show £59,883 for the first year of MSc Computer Science

**Think carefully if:**

- your IELTS is below 7.0 overall, or below 6.5 in any part, for MSc Computer Science
- you want MSc Data Science. Its tuition is £48,600 a year, which is £4,200 more than MSc Computer Science (£48,600 minus £44,400)
- you want the MBA. It needs three years of full-time work experience, and its listed location is Beijing

### Visa and health fees

- **Student visa application fee** for applying from outside the UK: **£558**.

Newcastle University teaches its postgraduate courses from its Newcastle city centre campus. This guide covers three one-year master's courses for September 2027 entry: MSc Computer Science, MSc Data Science and the MBA.

The most important thing to know is the cost. Tuition for MSc Computer Science is **£33,400** a year for 2027-28 entry. Scholarships can lower the amount you pay, so read the scholarships section before you budget.

## What it really costs

You pay for three things: tuition, a deposit, and the money you must show for your visa.

### Tuition

International tuition for 2027-28 entry is:

- MSc Computer Science: **£33,400** a year
- MSc Data Science: **£32,800** a year
- MBA: **£34,400** a year

Each course lasts 12 months full time.

### Deposit

Students from India must pay a tuition deposit of **£3,000** by **27 August 2027**, or send an official sponsorship letter by the same date. A deposit is an upfront payment that secures your place. A sponsorship letter is an official letter from the person or organisation paying for your studies. If your course needs an ATAS certificate, the date is **13 August 2027**.

### Money for the visa

The UK student visa needs proof that you can pay your living costs. Newcastle is outside London, so the rate for courses outside London applies. You must show **£1,171** for each month of your course, for up to **9 months**. You must have had this money for **28 days** in a row. The last day of that 28-day period must fall within **31 days** of the date you apply.

This is money you show, not a fee the university charges. Amounts change, so confirm them on gov.uk before you apply.

### First-year example: MSc Computer Science

| Item | How it is worked out | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| Tuition | Course fee, 2027-28 | £33,400 |
| Visa living money | £1,171 × 9 months | £10,539 |
| Student visa application fee | Applying from outside the UK | £558 |
| Immigration Health Surcharge | £776 + £388 (a visa of about 17 months) | £1,164 |
| **First-year total** | £33,400 + £10,539 + £558 + £1,164 | **£45,661** |

Your visa runs longer than your course. For a 12-month course it lasts about 17 months (1 month before the course and 4 months after). A visa of more than one year and up to 18 months pays the yearly £776 plus half of it, £388, so the surcharge is **£1,164**.

This is an example, not a budget. It leaves out flights, rent and everyday spending.

If you receive the £10,000 India Future Leaders award described below, tuition for this course falls to £23,400 (£33,400 − £10,000). The first-year total would then be £35,661 (£23,400 + £10,539 + £558 + £1,164).

Read the rules in our [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide). To compare costs across UK universities, use the [UK total cost breakdown](/study-abroad/study-in/uk/uk-total-cost-breakdown).

### Other visa documents

Besides the money, you need:

- **A CAS**, the Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies. Your course provider issues it, and you need it to apply.
- **A valid passport.**
- **English at CEFR level B2 or above** for degree study. CEFR is a common scale for language levels. Your university can assess your English itself. If it does not, you need an approved English test result.
- **A TB test, if you need one.** India is on the UK list of countries where the test applies. You need the test if all three of these are true: you are coming to the UK for 6 months or more; you have lived in a listed country for 6 months or more; you were living in a listed country within the last 6 months. The test must be done at a clinic approved by the Home Office.
- **An ATAS certificate, if your course needs one.** ATAS is the Academic Technology Approval Scheme. You must have it before you start the course. It can take 8 to 10 weeks.

You can apply for the visa no earlier than 6 months before your course starts.

## Ways to reduce the cost

Newcastle lists these awards for international students on its global scholarships page.

- **India Future Leaders Scholarship.** A **£10,000** tuition fee award. It is automatic, so there is no separate application. To qualify, you must be domiciled in India (your permanent home is in India), have an offer for 2027/28, pay the deposit in full by **2 August 2027**, and be assessed as an international student for fees. Check the award page for the courses it covers.
- **Vice-Chancellor's International award.** An **£8,000** tuition fee award. It is automatic once you apply for a course. You must accept your offer and pay the deposit in full by **2 August 2027**. The Vice-Chancellor is the university's head.
- **Vice-Chancellor's Excellence scholarship.** Up to **50%** off tuition. Apply through the scholarships section of the Apply to Newcastle portal by **8 June 2027**.

The MSc Computer Science course page says you may be eligible for a scholarship worth **25%** off the international fee. The page does not name the award, so check the course page to see who qualifies.

MBA applicants are also considered for MBA scholarships at interview. Ask the admissions team about the amount.

## Getting in

Each course sets its own degree rule. A UK honours degree comes in classes. A **2:1** (upper second) is a higher class than a **2:2** (lower second).

- **MSc Computer Science:** a 2:2 honours degree, or equivalent, in any subject except those related to computer science.
- **MSc Data Science:** a 2:2 honours degree, or international equivalent, plus GCSE Mathematics grade 6 or equivalent. GCSE is a school exam taken in the UK.
- **MBA:** a 2:1 honours degree, or international equivalent, plus at least three years of managerial work experience.

**Indian degrees.** On each course page, select India under "Qualifications from outside the UK" to see the grade table. It shows:

- For a 2:1, the grade table has three sections that depend on the university you studied at: Section 1 is **60%** or a CGPA of **6.0** out of 10, Section 2 is **62%** or **6.2**, and Section 3 is **65%** or **6.5**.
- For a 2:2, it asks for **58%** in Section 1, **60%** in Section 2 and **63%** in Section 3.

CGPA means cumulative grade point average, the 10-point scale that many Indian universities use.

**English.** Newcastle asks for IELTS, an English test that gives you a score for each part. The university's general rule is an IELTS overall score of **6.5**, with at least **5.5** in each part. Check the entry requirements on your course page, because they show the scores for your course.

|---|---|---|---|
| MSc Computer Science | September 2027 | No closing date | £3,000, or sponsorship letter, by 27 August 2027 |
| MSc Data Science | September 2027 | No closing date | £3,000, or sponsorship letter, by 27 August 2027 |

If your course needs an ATAS certificate, the deposit date is 13 August 2027.

Scholarship dates are separate. The India Future Leaders award and the Vice-Chancellor's International award need the deposit paid in full by 2 August 2027. The Vice-Chancellor's Excellence scholarship closes on 8 June 2027.

Newcastle advises you to apply two months before the course starts. Start the visa early as well. You can apply no earlier than 6 months before the start, and an ATAS certificate can take 8 to 10 weeks.

## Courses covered in this guide

- [MSc Computer Science](https://www.ncl.ac.uk/postgraduate/degrees/5055f/): 12 months full time, starting September 2027.
- [MSc Data Science](https://www.ncl.ac.uk/postgraduate/degrees/5543f/): 12 months full time, starting September 2027. The GCSE Mathematics rule above applies to this course.
- [MBA](https://www.ncl.ac.uk/postgraduate/degrees/5823f/): 12 months full time, starting September 2027. It needs work experience, as set out above.

The same department also runs the [Advanced Computer Science MSc](https://www.ncl.ac.uk/postgraduate/degrees/5178f/).

## Where you'll live

The School of Computing is based in the Urban Sciences Building at Newcastle Helix. The India Future Leaders award page refers to the Newcastle city centre campus.

Newcastle's postgraduate accommodation page gives a guarantee deadline of 30 June 2026 for the 2026 cycle. The 2027 deadline is not published yet. Check the [postgraduate accommodation page](https://www.ncl.ac.uk/accommodation/applying-for-accommodation/applying-for-postgraduate-accommodation/) for the current deadline, and the [room types page](https://www.ncl.ac.uk/accommodation/university/types/our-rooms/) for the rooms on offer.

## Who it's a good fit for

**A strong choice if:**

- You have a 2:2 or better in a subject other than computing, and you want a one-year computer science master's.
- You have a 2:1 and at least three years of managerial work experience, and you want an MBA.
- You can pay the £3,000 deposit, or send a sponsorship letter, by 27 August 2027.

**Think carefully if:**

- You hold a computer science degree. The MSc Computer Science course does not accept degrees related to computer science.
- Your Indian degree is below the 58% or CGPA 5.8 level in the grade table.
- You cannot show £1,171 a month for up to 9 months, held for 28 days in a row.

To compare costs with other options, see the [UK total cost breakdown](/study-abroad/study-in/uk/uk-total-cost-breakdown).

fields.meta_description: UK student visa guide for Indian students: £558 fee, £776-a-year health surcharge, money to show for 9 months, documents, TB test and the Graduate visa.
fields.body_md:
## The short answer

- **Visa fee:** **£558** to apply from outside the UK.
- **Immigration Health Surcharge** (a fee that covers your use of the UK health service, the NHS): **£776 for each year** of your visa. For a 12-month course the visa runs about 17 months, so the surcharge is **£1,164** (the yearly £776 plus half of it, £388).
- **Money to show:** your course fee for the first year, plus **£1,171 a month** outside London or **£1,529 a month** in London, for up to **9 months**.
- **Keep the money** in your account for **28 days in a row**.
- **Decision time:** usually **3 weeks** if you apply from outside the UK.

## When to apply

Apply after your university gives you a **Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies (CAS)**. A CAS is a reference number that proves the university will teach you. It also shows the course fee you must be able to pay for the first year.

From outside the UK, you can apply up to **6 months** before your course starts. From inside the UK, the earliest is **3 months** before.

## Documents you need

- Your **CAS reference number** from the university.
- Your valid **passport**.
- **Proof of your money** (see the next section).
- **Proof of English.** For degree study the level is **CEFR B2**. Your university can check your English itself, as long as the result is equal to B2.
- **TB test result.** You need one if you will stay 6 months or more and have lived in a listed country for 6 months or more. India is on the list. Take the test at a Home Office approved clinic.

## Money you need to show

You need enough money to pay for your course for **1 academic year** (up to 9 months). The amount is on your CAS.

You also need living money, shown separately:

| Where you study | Living money per month | For up to 9 months |
|---|---|---|
| Outside London | **£1,171** | **£10,539** |
| London | **£1,529** | **£13,761** |

The money must stay in your account for **28 days in a row**. This is money you must show, not what you will spend.

## Steps to apply

1. Get your **CAS** from your university.
2. Check that your money meets the rule above.
3. Apply online and pay the **£558** visa fee and the health surcharge (**£776 for each year** of your visa).
4. Prove your identity as part of the application.
5. Wait for a decision. It usually takes **3 weeks** from outside the UK and **8 weeks** from inside the UK.

## After you finish your degree

The **Graduate visa** lets you stay in the UK after your degree. If you apply on or before **31 December 2026** it lasts **2 years**. If you apply on or after **1 January 2027** it lasts **18 months**. The fee is **£937**, plus a health surcharge that is usually **£1,035 a year**.

## Sources

Official pages, checked on 1 and 2 November 2026: [Student visa](https://www.gov.uk/student-visa), [Money you need](https://www.gov.uk/student-visa/money), [Knowledge of English](https://www.gov.uk/student-visa/knowledge-of-english), [Apply](https://www.gov.uk/student-visa/apply), [TB test](https://www.gov.uk/tb-test-visa/who-needs-a-tb-test), [Graduate visa](https://www.gov.uk/graduate-visa), [Healthcare surcharge](https://www.gov.uk/healthcare-immigration-application/how-much-pay).

fields.body_md:
## The short answer

- **Tuition** for a one-year master's runs from **£19,980** (Coventry, Computer Science) to **£62,500** (Warwick, MBA).
- Most Computer Science and Data Science fees sit between **£32,800** and **£48,600**.
- **Visa fee:** **£558**.
- **Immigration Health Surcharge** (a fee that covers your use of the UK health service, the NHS): **£776 for each year** of your visa. For a 12-month course the visa runs about 17 months, so the surcharge is **£1,164** (the yearly £776 plus half of it, £388).
- **Living money you must show:** **£1,171 a month** outside London, **£1,529 a month** in London, for up to **9 months**.

## Tuition by university

These are the fees for the whole one-year course, for students from overseas, for 2027 or 2027-28 entry. Manchester's MBA is the whole 15 or 18 month programme. A dash means we have not added that course yet. Check your own course page before you apply.

| University | MSc Computer Science | MSc Data Science | MBA |
|---|---|---|---|
| Coventry | £19,980 | – | £21,825 |
| Newcastle | £33,400 | £32,800 | £34,400 |
| Sheffield | £34,550 | £36,055 | £37,630 |
| Leeds | £34,600 | £34,600 (Data Science and Analytics) | £41,200 |
| Nottingham | £34,800 | £34,800 | – |
| Glasgow | £34,815 (Computing Science) | – | £41,100 |
| Southampton | £36,800 | £36,800 | £37,400 |
| Birmingham | £36,000 | £36,000 | £40,410 |
| Warwick | – | £39,330 (Statistics with Data Science) | £62,500 |
| Manchester | £41,400 (Advanced Computer Science) | – | £51,500 (whole programme) |
| UCL | £44,400 | £48,600 | – |
| Edinburgh | £47,680 | £47,680 | £47,680 |

## Money you must show for the visa

The UK asks you to show living money for up to **9 months**. Outside London that is **£1,171** a month, which comes to **£10,539**. In London it is **£1,529** a month, which comes to **£13,761**. The money must stay in your account for **28 days in a row**. This is money you must show, not what you will spend. Read the full rules in our [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide).

## Visa and health fees

- **Student visa:** **£558**, paid when you apply.
- **Health surcharge:** **£776 for each year** of your visa. For a 12-month course the visa runs about 17 months, so the surcharge is **£1,164** (the yearly £776 plus half of it, £388). A one-year master's usually pays **£1,164**.

## Worked example: MSc Computer Science at Sheffield

Tuition **£34,550** + money to show outside London **£10,539** + visa **£558** + health surcharge **£1,164** = **£46,811**. This uses Sheffield's 2027-28 fee and the visa rules. It is an example, not a budget.

## Scholarships that lower the cost

- **Edinburgh India Merit Scholarship:** £5,000 off first-year tuition for Indian graduates joining a full-time master's. No separate application.
- **GREAT Scholarships:** £10,000 towards tuition at 13 participating UK universities in 2026-27. None of the 12 universities above is on that list.
- **Commonwealth Master's Scholarship:** full tuition fees, airfare and **£1,712** a month. The 2027/28 round has closed.

## Sources

Checked on 1 and 2 November 2026: [Student visa](https://www.gov.uk/student-visa), [Money you need](https://www.gov.uk/student-visa/money), [Healthcare surcharge](https://www.gov.uk/healthcare-immigration-application/how-much-pay), and each university's own course page, for example [UCL Computer Science](https://www.ucl.ac.uk/study/prospective-students/graduate/courses/computer-science-msc) and [Sheffield Computer Science](https://sheffield.ac.uk/postgraduate/taught/courses/2027/computer-science-msc). The full list is in the UK research notes.
